relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Leishmaniasis can be directly transmitted via intravenous needle sharing, bypassing insect vectors among urban drug abusers in Southern Europe.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, young pediatric age, infants, preschool children, zoonotic VL
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Leishmaniasis exhibits peak susceptibility in young pediatric age groups, who comprise the vast majority of zoonotic Leishmania infantum cases in Latin America and the Mediterranean.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, nonimmune immigrant status, refugees, population displacement
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Leishmaniasis triggers catastrophic epidemics among individuals with nonimmune immigrant status moving into hyperendemic transmission foci without acquired immunity.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, indolent incubation months, 2 to 8 months, delayed onset
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Leishmaniasis features an indolent incubation months timeframe for visceral disease, typically requiring 2 to 8 months between sandfly inoculation and full clinical illness.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, cutaneous incubation weeks, 2 to 8 weeks, bite papule
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Leishmaniasis features a cutaneous incubation weeks timeframe, wherein localized papules and ulcers emerge 2 to 8 weeks following the primary sandfly bite.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, delayed mucosal latency, espundia latency, years post-ulcer
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Leishmaniasis exhibits delayed mucosal latency, with destructive mucocutaneous espundia arising months to decades after the initial cutaneous sore has completely healed.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, termite mound proximity, sandfly resting, savannah microhabitat
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Leishmaniasis exposure is heightened by termite mound proximity, which provides ideal cool, humid subterranean daytime resting sites for Phlebotomus sandflies.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, post conflict migration, war zones, disrupted vector control
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Leishmaniasis transmission explodes during post conflict migration, as documented during refugee displacements in Syria, Afghanistan, and South Sudan.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, marked leukocytosis, neutrophilia, pyogenic
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Uncomplicated visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by marked neutrophilic leukocytosis, which points strongly toward pyogenic bacterial sepsis or occult bacterial abscesses.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, absence of splenomegaly, normal spleen
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by absence of splenomegaly in prolonged febrile illness, as reticuloendothelial splenic parasitization invariably produces splenomegaly.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, anesthetic skin lesion, loss of sensation, leprosy
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by an anesthetic skin lesion, as cutaneous leishmania lesions retain intact sensation, whereas tactile loss signifies tuberculoid leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, painful purulent ulcer, acute pyoderma, bacterial
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Uncomplicated cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by an acutely painful purulent ulcer, which indicates acute pyogenic bacterial pyoderma or ecthyma.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, enlarged peripheral nerves, nerve hypertrophy, leprosy
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by enlarged peripheral nerves, a definitive neurological sign indicating Mycobacterium leprae neurotropism.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, acute onset 24 hours, hyperacute fever, dengue, malaria
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by acute onset within 24 hours, as Leishmania requires weeks to months of indolent incubation before clinical manifestations emerge.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, overt jaundice, hyperbilirubinemia, viral hepatitis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Uncomplicated visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by hyperbilirubinemic overt jaundice at admission, which signifies acute viral hepatitis, biliary sepsis, or Weil disease.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, intrahepatic cystic lesions, liver cysts, hydatid
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Leishmaniasis is ruled out by intrahepatic cystic lesions on ultrasound, an imaging finding pathognomonic of cystic echinococcosis or amebic abscess.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, rapid antibacterial response, beta lactam defervescence
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Leishmaniasis is ruled out by rapid antibacterial response to standard beta-lactams, as Leishmania protozoa are completely refractory to antibacterial antibiotics.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, absolute eosinophilia, eosinophils > 3000, helminth
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by marked absolute eosinophilia, as leishmaniasis typically causes eosinopenia or neutropenia, whereas extreme eosinophilia indicates invasive helminthiasis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, circulating peripheral blasts, myeloblasts, leukemia
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by circulating peripheral blasts on admission blood smear, which establishes a primary hematological malignancy such as acute leukemia.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, intraerythrocytic plasmodial rings, malaria trophozoites
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Leishmaniasis as the primary etiology of acute fever is ruled out by intraerythrocytic plasmodial rings on blood film, confirming active malaria.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, pipestem periportal fibrosis, Symmers fibrosis, schistosoma
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by pipestem periportal fibrosis on ultrasound, a pathognomonic hallmark of chronic hepatosplenic schistosomiasis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, acid fast bacilli, positive Ziehl Neelsen, mycobacteria
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by abundant acid fast bacilli on lesion smear, confirming cutaneous tuberculosis, leprosy, or Buruli ulcer.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, centrally painful eschar, tender black necrosis, rickettsia
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Uncomplicated cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by a centrally painful eschar with acute regional toxemia, which indicates scrub typhus or cutaneous anthrax.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, caseating necrosis, caseous granuloma, tuberculosis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by extensive caseating granulomatous necrosis on biopsy, which points decisively toward mycobacterial tuberculosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, normal serum immunoglobulins, normal IgG, normal protein
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Chronic visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by normal serum immunoglobulins, as prolonged visceral disease invariably triggers massive polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, prompt antimalarial response, artemisinin cure
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by prompt antimalarial response within 48 hours of artemisinin administration, as antimalarials exert no antileishmanial activity.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, pure scalp lesions, hairy scalp, sparing
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Cutaneous leishmaniasis is ruled out by lesions confined purely to the scalp, as sandflies rarely penetrate thick scalp hair to bite, sparing this anatomical site.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, solitary lung cavitation, apical cavity, tuberculosis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Primary visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by solitary lung cavitation on chest radiography, which establishes active cavitary pulmonary tuberculosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, normal spleen size, no splenomegaly, ultrasound normal
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by strictly normal spleen size on ultrasound, as reticuloendothelial proliferation inevitably produces sonographically detectable splenomegaly.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, severe hemolysis bilirubin, dark urine, hemoglobinuria
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Visceral leishmaniasis is ruled out by acute severe hemolysis with hemoglobinuria, which indicates blackwater fever, severe G6PD crisis, or autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, malaria, Plasmodium, blood film, intraerythrocytic
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from malaria by double-peaking daily fevers, profound leukopenia, astronomical hypergammaglobulinemia, and presence of LD bodies on marrow aspirate rather than intraerythrocytic plasmodia.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, schistosomiasis, Symmers fibrosis, portal hypertension
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from schistosomiasis by prolonged high fevers, profound pancytopenia, and marrow amastigotes, whereas hepatosplenic schistosomiasis is afebrile with periportal pipestem fibrosis on ultrasound.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, leprosy, Mycobacterium leprae, anesthetic patch, thickened nerves
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from leprosy by completely preserved cutaneous sensation within ulcers, lack of peripheral nerve thickening, and intracellular amastigotes rather than acid-fast globi.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, cutaneous anthrax, Bacillus anthracis, black eschar, gelatinous edema
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from cutaneous anthrax by chronic indolent duration over weeks to months with granular crater bases, whereas anthrax causes rapid 48-hour black eschar with striking gelatinous non-pitting edema.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, disseminated histoplasmosis, Histoplasma capsulatum, intracellular yeast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from disseminated histoplasmosis by identification of a rod-shaped purplish kinetoplast in amastigotes, whereas Histoplasma yeasts exhibit narrow-based budding without kinetoplast structures.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, visceral brucellosis, Brucella melitensis, undulant fever, unpasteurized milk
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from visceral brucellosis by massive splenomegaly reaching the pelvic brim, extreme hypergammaglobulinemia, positive rK39 dipstick, and lack of response to doxycycline-rifampin regimens.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, typhoid fever, enteric fever, Salmonella Typhi, stepladder fever
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from typhoid fever by subacute indolent progression over months rather than an acute 1-to-2 week stepladder fever, absence of relative bradycardia, and refractoriness to ceftriaxone.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, hyperreactive malarial splenomegaly, HMS, high IgM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from tropical splenomegaly syndrome (HMS) by persistent fevers, extreme polyclonal IgG elevation rather than selective IgM spikes, and demonstration of LD amastigotes on bone marrow.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, cutaneous tuberculosis, lupus vulgaris, scrofuloderma, apple jelly
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from cutaneous tuberculosis (lupus vulgaris) by absence of yellowish apple-jelly nodules on diascopy, absence of caseous necrosis on biopsy, and demonstration of intracellular amastigotes.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, acute myeloid leukemia, AML, blast cells, marrow infiltration
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from acute myeloid leukemia by absence of clonal myeloblasts on marrow aspirate and identification of diagnostic Leishman-Donovan amastigotes within normal histiocytic elements.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, Hodgkin lymphoma, Pel Ebstein fever, Reed Sternberg cells
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from Hodgkin lymphoma by prominent pancytopenia, massive diffuse splenic enlargement, and absence of characteristic binucleate Reed-Sternberg giant cells on nodal biopsy.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, amebic liver abscess, Entamoeba histolytica, anchovy sauce, cystic cavity
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from amebic liver abscess by marked splenomegaly, profound leukopenia, and homogeneous hepatic ultrasound, whereas amebic abscess shows focal liquefactive cavities with anchovy-paste aspirate.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, bacterial pyoderma, ecthyma, Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus pyogenes
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from bacterial pyoderma (ecthyma) by its indolent weeks-to-months course, painless crater with rolled violaceous border, and complete lack of response to first-generation cephalosporins.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, sporotrichosis, Sporothrix schenckii, rose gardener, nodular lymphangitis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from sporotrichosis by identification of kinetoplast-containing amastigotes on smear, lack of fungal cigar-shaped budding yeasts on PAS stain, and sandfly rather than thorn exposure.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, yaws, Treponema pallidum pertenue, frambesia, papilloma
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from yaws by negative rapid treponemal serology, absence of spirochetes on darkfield microscopy, and complete refractoriness to single-dose intramuscular benzathine penicillin.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, paracoccidioidomycosis, Paracoccidioides, mariner's wheel, mulberry stomatitis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from paracoccidioidomycosis by absence of pathognomonic mariner's wheel multi-budding yeasts on direct KOH examination and presence of LD amastigotes inside mucosal histiocytes.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, chromoblastomycosis, muriform cells, Medlar bodies, verrucous plaque
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from chromoblastomycosis by absence of pigmented thick-walled sclerotic muriform Medlar bodies ('copper pennies') on 10% KOH scrapings of skin lesions.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, Buruli ulcer, Mycobacterium ulcerans, undermined borders, mycolactone necrosis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leishmaniasis is differentiated from Buruli ulcer by rolled raised violaceous indurated borders rather than widely undermined necrotic edges, and demonstration of amastigotes rather than acid-fast bacilli in subcutaneous fat.

entities.name: Leprosy
entities.description: A chronic granulomatous infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium leprae and Mycobacterium lepromatosis, displaying exclusive tropism for Schwann cells and dermal histiocytes, causing anesthetic cutaneous lesions, peripheral nerve trunk enlargement, and progressive physical deformities.

entities.name: Tuberculoid Leprosy
entities.description: High-resistance polar form presenting with solitary or few well-demarcated hypopigmented or erythematous anesthetic plaques.

entities.name: Borderline Tuberculoid Leprosy
entities.description: Borderline spectrum form with multiple asymmetrical anesthetic plaques and satellite lesions.

entities.name: Mid-Borderline Leprosy
entities.description: Dimorphous intermediate form with inverted-saucer or swiss-cheese annular plaques.

entities.name: Borderline Lepromatous Leprosy
entities.description: Multibacillary form with numerous poorly defined plaques and partial sensory preservation.

entities.name: Lepromatous Leprosy
entities.description: Anergic polar form with widespread symmetric infiltration, macules, and lepromas.

entities.name: Indeterminate Leprosy
entities.description: Earliest transient stage presenting with faint hypopigmented macules and slight sensory loss.

entities.name: Pure Neural Leprosy
entities.description: Primary neural involvement without skin lesions, causing mononeuropathy multiplex.

entities.name: Histoid Leprosy
entities.description: Lepromatous variant presenting with succulent keloid-like nodules on normal skin.

entities.name: Lucio Leprosy
entities.description: Diffuse non-nodular lepromatous form with generalized shiny waxy dermal infiltration.

entities.name: Lucio Phenomenon
entities.description: Severe necrotizing vasculopathy with jagged purpura and cutaneous infarcts.

entities.name: Type 1 Reversal Reaction
entities.description: Delayed-type hypersensitivity reaction causing acute plaque erythema and neuritis.

entities.name: Erythema Nodosum Leprosum
entities.description: Type 2 immune-complex vasculitis with crops of tender subcutaneous nodules and fever.

entities.name: Silent Neuritis
entities.description: Asymptomatic progressive loss of nerve function without spontaneous pain or tenderness.

entities.name: Acute Leprous Neuritis
entities.description: Acute inflammatory nerve trunk swelling with intense pain, tenderness, and weakness.

entities.name: Chronic Neuropathic Pain
entities.description: Persistent dysesthesias and burning pain along fibrosed peripheral nerves.

entities.name: Atrophic Rhinitis
entities.description: Chronic nasal crusting, foul discharge, and mucosal atrophy from bacillary invasion.

entities.name: Nasal Septal Perforation
entities.description: Destruction and perforation of the cartilaginous nasal septum from subperichondrial infiltration.

entities.name: Leprous Orchitis
entities.description: Inflammatory testicular swelling and parenchyma destruction in multibacillary disease.

entities.name: Testicular Atrophy
entities.description: Bilateral fibrotic shrinkage of testes leading to hypogonadism, impotence, and sterility.

entities.name: Gynecomastia
entities.description: Endocrine-mediated glandular breast enlargement in males secondary to testicular failure.

entities.name: Chronic Iridocyclitis
entities.description: Granulomatous anterior uveitis causing iris pearls, synechiae, and visual loss.

entities.name: Exposure Keratitis
entities.description: Corneal drying, ulceration, and opacity resulting from paralytic lagophthalmos.

entities.name: Episcleritis
entities.description: Inflammatory congestion of episcleral tissue occurring during systemic ENL attacks.

entities.name: Corneal Hypesthesia
entities.description: Loss of protective corneal touch sensation from trigeminal nerve damage.

entities.name: Immune Complex Glomerulonephritis
entities.description: Renal glomerular injury driven by circulating immune complex deposition in ENL.

entities.name: Secondary Amyloidosis
entities.description: Systemic AA amyloid deposition in kidneys, liver, and spleen from chronic inflammation.

entities.name: Hepatic Granulomas
entities.description: Granulomatous histiocytic infiltration of Kupffer cells and liver parenchyma.

entities.name: Splenomegaly
entities.description: Enlargement of spleen from bacillary seeding and reticuloendothelial hyperplasia.

entities.name: Bone Marrow Bacillemia
entities.description: Marrow infiltration by bacilli-laden Virchow cells during bacteremic dissemination.

entities.name: Superficial Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Rubbery, non-tender enlargement of lymph node chains draining affected skin.

entities.name: Dermal Anhidrosis
entities.description: Local cessation of eccrine sweat production caused by sympathetic denervation.

entities.name: Cutaneous Alopecia
entities.description: Destruction of hair follicles and alopecia within cutaneous leprous lesions.

entities.name: Acral Lymphedema
entities.description: Chronic non-pitting lymphedema of hands and feet from lymphatic obliteration.

entities.name: Ichthyosiform Skin Changes
entities.description: Dry, cracked, fish-scale skin xerosis from autonomic denervation and sebaceous atrophy.

entities.name: Plantar Neuropathic Ulceration
entities.description: Chronic painless mal perforant ulcers over weight-bearing points of the foot.

entities.name: Digital Acro-Osteolysis
entities.description: Painless trophic bone resorption and shortening of phalanges in fingers and toes.

entities.name: Leprous Dactylitis
entities.description: Fusiform inflammatory swelling of digits during acute Type 2 reactional states.

entities.name: Systemic Reactive Arthritis
entities.description: Polyarticular synovial inflammation and joint effusion occurring during ENL.

entities.name: Upper Airway Stridor
entities.description: Inspiratory stridor from mucosal infiltration and edema of laryngeal structures.

entities.name: Peripheral Autonomic Dysautonomia
entities.description: Microvascular dysregulation causing cyanosis, cold extremities, and vasomotor failure.

entities.name: Anesthetic Skin Patch
entities.description: Well-demarcated hypopigmented or erythematous patch with definite sensory loss.

entities.name: Ulnar Nerve Enlargement
entities.description: Palpably thickened, firm, tender nerve trunk proximal to the medial epicondyle.

entities.name: Common Peroneal Nerve Enlargement
entities.description: Palpable nerve trunk winding around the fibular neck, leading to foot drop.

entities.name: Great Auricular Nerve Enlargement
entities.description: Prominent visible and palpable nerve trunk crossing the sternocleidomastoid muscle.

entities.name: Posterior Tibial Nerve Thickening
entities.description: Palpable enlargement behind the medial malleolus causing plantar anesthesia.

entities.name: Radial Cutaneous Nerve Thickening
entities.description: Palpable superficial sensory nerve thickening over the distal radius.

entities.name: Median Nerve Thickening
entities.description: Palpable nerve swelling in the distal forearm above the flexor retinaculum.

entities.name: Facies Leontina
entities.description: Deep furrowing and nodular facial infiltration producing a lion-like appearance.

entities.name: Madarosis
entities.description: Bilateral loss of eyebrows and eyelashes commencing at the lateral margins.

entities.name: Claw Hand Deformity
entities.description: Intrinsic muscle paralysis causing hyperextension of MCP and flexion of IP joints.

entities.name: Lagophthalmos
entities.description: Inability to fully close palpebral fissures from orbicularis oculi paralysis.

entities.name: Foot Drop
entities.description: Paralytic loss of ankle dorsiflexion producing high-steppage compensatory gait.

entities.name: Saddle Nose Deformity
entities.description: Collapse of the cartilaginous nasal bridge following septal destruction.

entities.name: Pendulous Infiltrated Earlobes
entities.description: Thickened, elongated, nodular earlobes from histiocytic bacillary accumulation.

entities.name: Ape Hand Deformity
entities.description: Flattening of thenar eminence and loss of thumb opposition from median neuropathy.

entities.name: Wrist Drop Deformity
entities.description: Inability to extend wrist and fingers caused by radial motor nerve destruction.

entities.name: Hypothenar Muscle Atrophy
entities.description: Wasting and hollowing of hypothenar eminence resulting from ulnar denervation.

entities.name: First Web Space Wasting
entities.description: Deep guttering of dorsal interosseous muscle between thumb and index finger.

entities.name: Claw Toe Deformity
entities.description: Hyperextension of MTP and flexion of IP toe joints from intrinsic foot denervation.

entities.name: Mal Perforant Plantar Ulcer
entities.description: Indolent calloused trophic ulceration beneath metatarsal heads or heel.

entities.name: Corneal Opacification
entities.description: Scarring and haziness of cornea secondary to lagophthalmos and trauma.

entities.name: Iris Pearls
entities.description: Glistening tiny white granulomatous nodules along the pupillary margin.

entities.name: Ectropion
entities.description: Outward sagging and eversion of lower eyelid from facial nerve denervation.

entities.name: Tender Subcutaneous Nodules
entities.description: Eruption of painful erythematous subcutaneous nodules across limbs in ENL.

entities.name: Foveal Annular Plaques
entities.description: Plaques with punched-out hypochromic center and sloping borders in BB leprosy.

entities.name: Satellite Skin Lesions
entities.description: Smaller secondary anesthetic macules surrounding a dominant primary plaque.

entities.name: Cigarette Paper Wrinkling
entities.description: Fine atrophic wrinkling of epidermis over healing anesthetic tuberculoid plaques.

entities.name: Waddell High-Steppage Gait
entities.description: Exaggerated hip flexion gait pattern to lift a flaccid dropped foot.

entities.name: Slit-Skin Smear Acid-Fast Bacilli
entities.description: Identification of acid-fast bacilli on Fite-Faraco stained dermal smears.

entities.name: Bacteriological Index Score
entities.description: Logarithmic quantification (0 to 6+) of bacillary density across dermal smears.

entities.name: Intracellular Dermal Globi
entities.description: Cigar-bundle clusters and dense aggregates of M. leprae inside Virchow cells.

entities.name: Morphological Index Determination
entities.description: Percentage of solid viable bacilli relative to fragmented non-viable forms.

entities.name: High-Resolution Nerve Ultrasound
entities.description: Bedside sonography showing nerve enlargement and loss of fascicular pattern.

entities.name: Nerve Cross-Sectional Area Enlargement
entities.description: Ultrasound cross-sectional area >10-12 mm² in ulnar or peroneal nerve trunks.

entities.name: Intraneural Hypervascular Doppler Flow
entities.description: Increased color Doppler endoneurial blood flow reflecting active neuritis.

entities.name: Hierarchical Cutaneous Sensory Loss
entities.description: Sequential loss of temperature first, light touch second, and pinprick pain last.

entities.name: Thermal Sensation Loss
entities.description: Failure to discriminate hot from cold water tubes applied to skin patches.

entities.name: Light Touch Monofilament Impairment
entities.description: Inability to perceive Semmes-Weinstein monofilaments on lesion testing.

entities.name: Pinprick Pain Hypoesthesia
entities.description: Diminished or absent perception of sharp pinprick sensation within lesions.

entities.name: Voluntary Muscle Testing Deficit
entities.description: Standardized MRC motor grading reduction in hand and foot intrinsic muscles.

entities.name: Lepromin Skin Test Negativity
entities.description: Absence of Mitsuda induration at 28 days indicating lepromatous anergy.

entities.name: Lepromin Skin Test Positivity
entities.description: Induration >5 mm at 28 days demonstrating intact cell-mediated immunity.

entities.name: Tuberculoid Dermal Epithelioid Granulomas
entities.description: Epithelioid granulomas with Langhans cells destroying cutaneous nerves.

entities.name: Lepromatous Foamy Virchow Histiocytes
entities.description: Diffuse sheets of lipid-laden foamy histiocytes packed with acid-fast bacilli.

entities.name: Grenz Zone Preservation
entities.description: Clear subepidermal band of uninvolved collagen above lepromatous infiltrate.

entities.name: Nerve Fascicle Fibrosis
entities.description: Endoneurial collagen deposition and axonal loss visualized on nerve biopsy.

entities.name: Anti-PGL-1 IgM Seropositivity
entities.description: Elevated serum IgM antibodies targeting M. leprae phenolic glycolipid-1.

entities.name: ML-Flow Lateral Flow Positivity
entities.description: Point-of-care lateral flow visual band detecting anti-PGL-1 IgM antibodies.

entities.name: Mycobacterium leprae PCR Positivity
entities.description: PCR amplification of specific RLEP repetitive element DNA sequences.

entities.name: Marked Neutrophilic Leukocytosis
entities.description: Leukocytosis (15,000–25,000/µL) with left shift during Type 2 ENL episodes.

entities.name: Elevated Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate
entities.description: Marked ESR elevation (>80–120 mm/h) during acute inflammatory reactional states.

entities.name: Markedly Elevated C-Reactive Protein
entities.description: High serum CRP (>50–150 mg/L) marking systemic vasculitis in ENL attacks.

entities.name: Immune Complex Proteinuria
entities.description: Proteinuria resulting from immune-complex glomerulonephritis during ENL.

entities.name: Microscopic Hematuria
entities.description: Urinary red blood cell casts indicating active glomerular inflammation in ENL.

entities.name: Secondary Normocytic Normochromic Anemia
entities.description: Anemia of chronic disease and marrow reticuloendothelial iron blockade.

entities.name: Polyclonal Hypergammaglobulinemia
entities.description: Broad-based increase in gamma globulins with reversed A:G ratio in MB cases.

entities.name: Biologic False-Positive VDRL
entities.description: Positive non-treponemal syphilis serology with negative treponemal tests.

entities.name: Serum Tumor Necrosis Factor-Alpha
entities.description: High circulating TNF-alpha driving fever and tissue necrosis in ENL.

entities.name: Serum Interleukin-6 Elevation
entities.description: Elevated IL-6 reflecting B-cell activation and immune complex vasculitis.

entities.name: Decreased Serum Testosterone
entities.description: Subnormal testosterone levels from lepromatous destruction of Leydig cells.

entities.name: Elevated Luteinizing Hormone
entities.description: Compensatory rise in LH and FSH indicating primary testicular failure.

entities.name: Plain Radiography Acro-Osteolysis
entities.description: Pencil-pointing and cortical absorption of distal phalanges on X-ray.

entities.name: Soft Tissue Neuropathic Resorption
entities.description: Loss of terminal phalangeal soft tissue tufts from repeated microtrauma.

entities.name: Nerve Conduction Velocity Slowing
entities.description: Electromyographic motor and sensory slowing across enlarged nerve trunks.

entities.name: Reduced Sensory Action Potentials
entities.description: Severely attenuated or absent SNAP amplitudes documenting axonal loss.

entities.name: Intraneural Caseous Necrosis
entities.description: Fluid-filled cold nerve abscess cavities visualized on nerve sonography.

entities.name: Untreated Multibacillary Household Contact
entities.description: Cohabitation with an untreated patient discharging viable bacilli in droplets.

entities.name: Nasal Droplet Aerosol Transmission
entities.description: Inhalation of infectious droplets and dried secretions from coughing and sneezing.

entities.name: Nine-Banded Armadillo Exposure
entities.description: Contact with wild Dasypus novemcinctus, sylvatic reservoirs in the Americas.

entities.name: Red Squirrel Zoonotic Reservoir
entities.description: Sylvatic contact with wild Sciurus vulgaris harboring M. leprae in the UK.

entities.name: Non-Human Primate Reservoir
entities.description: Zoonotic contact with infected chimpanzees or sooty mangabeys in Africa.

entities.name: Superficial Skin Inoculation
entities.description: Percutaneous bacillary entry via preexisting skin cuts or microtrauma.

entities.name: Endemic Developing Country Residence
entities.description: Extended living or travel in tropical nations with ongoing endemic transmission.

entities.name: South-East Asia Regional Endemicity
entities.description: Residence in South-East Asia accounting for >70% of new global cases.

entities.name: Poverty and Household Crowding
entities.description: Crowded substandard living conditions facilitating droplet transmission.

entities.name: Pediatric Household Contact
entities.description: Children under 15 cohabiting with cases, marking active transmission.

entities.name: Multi-Year Incubation Period
entities.description: Paucibacillary disease incubation typically spanning 3 to 5 years.

entities.name: Decade-Long Incubation Period
entities.description: Multibacillary incubation extending 5 to 10 years, up to 20 years.

entities.name: Host Genetic Susceptibility
entities.description: Inherited polymorphisms altering macrophage handling of mycobacteria.

entities.name: HLA-DR2 and HLA-DR3 Alleles
entities.description: Class II HLA alleles conferring strong predisposition to tuberculoid disease.

entities.name: HLA-DQ1 Allele
entities.description: Class II HLA allele predisposing to anergic lepromatous leprosy forms.

entities.name: PARK2 and PACRG Polymorphisms
entities.description: Promoter variants impairing ubiquitin-mediated macrophage destruction of bacilli.

entities.name: MRC1 Exon 7 Polymorphisms
entities.description: Mannose receptor variants conferring vulnerability to multibacillary disease.

entities.name: Innate Natural Resistance
entities.description: Natural genetic immunity present in >95% of human population.

entities.name: Post-Exposure Household Prophylaxis
entities.description: Lack of single-dose rifampicin post-exposure prophylaxis increasing attack rate.

entities.name: Pregnancy and Puerperium
entities.description: Gestational immune shifts precipitating initial disease or reactional flares.

entities.name: Immunosuppressive Therapy Host
entities.description: Anti-TNF biologics and corticosteroids precipitating disease reactivation.

entities.name: Subclinical Upper Airway Carriage
entities.description: Transient nasal carriage and shedding in asymptomatic household contacts.

entities.name: Intact Cutaneous Temperature Sensation
entities.description: Completely preserved cold and warm sensation within a solitary skin lesion.

entities.name: Intact Fine Light Touch
entities.description: Normal light touch perception via nylon monofilaments inside skin patch.

entities.name: Severe Cutaneous Pruritus
entities.description: Intense itching, scratching, or excoriations within cutaneous lesions.

entities.name: Acute Symptom Onset
entities.description: Rapid onset of skin eruptions or nerve weakness over days to weeks.

entities.name: Normal Peripheral Nerve Caliber
entities.description: Absence of nerve enlargement or tenderness across all peripheral trunks.

entities.name: Preserved Sweating and Hair
entities.description: Intact sweating and hair follicle growth within an isolated macule.

entities.name: Strictly Symmetrical Polyneuropathy
entities.description: Length-dependent stocking-glove neuropathy lacking macules or nerve swelling.

entities.name: Rapid Ceftriaxone Clinical Response
entities.description: Rapid lesion clearance on cephalosporins or penicillins excludes M. leprae.

entities.name: Excoriated Pruritic Web Burrows
entities.description: Interdigital excoriated burrows with nocturnal itching from scabies mites.

entities.name: Central Spontaneous Ulcerative Slough
entities.description: Rapid necrotic ulceration and sloughing over days typical of pyoderma.

entities.name: Transient Migratory Skin Rash
entities.description: Evanescent wheals or plaques spontaneously resolving within 24–48 hours.

entities.name: Normal Slit-Skin Smears
entities.description: Repeatedly negative slit smears at cold sites rules out LL and BL disease.

entities.name: Prominent Mucosal Oral Aphthae
entities.description: Recurrent painful oral aphthous ulcerations typical of Behçet disease.

entities.name: Preserved Corneal Sensation
entities.description: Normal corneal touch reflexes in isolated peripheral facial palsy.

entities.name: Absence of Nerve Thickening
entities.description: Lack of palpable thickening across ulnar, peroneal, and auricular nerves.

entities.name: Rapid Defervescence on Penicillin
entities.description: Resolution of fever and tender nodules within 48 hours of penicillin.

entities.name: Epidermal Hyphae on KOH
entities.description: Fungal hyphae and spores on potassium hydroxide scraping examination.

entities.name: Normal Nerve Fascicular Architecture
entities.description: Preserved fascicular architecture and normal cross-sectional areas on US.

entities.name: Prominent Targetoid Lesions
entities.description: Concentric targetoid lesions with mucosal crusting in erythema multiforme.

entities.name: Acute Asymmetric Flaccid Paralysis
entities.description: Sudden painless lower motor neuron paralysis over 24–48 hours.

entities.name: Completely Intact Tendon Reflexes
entities.description: Brisk tendon reflexes with normal sensory exam in a limb rules out leprosy.

entities.name: Vitiligo
entities.description: Autoimmune depigmentation disorder with chalk-white macules and intact sensation.

entities.name: Pityriasis Versicolor
entities.description: Superficial fungal infection causing scaly macules with intact sensory function.

entities.name: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Protozoal ulcerations with indurated borders, intact sensation, and amastigotes.

entities.name: Sarcoidosis
entities.description: Systemic granulomatosis with non-caseating plaques, intact sensation, and adenopathy.

entities.name: Cutaneous Tuberculosis
entities.description: Lupus vulgaris plaques with apple-jelly nodules on diascopy and intact sensation.

entities.name: Diabetic Neuropathy
entities.description: Symmetric length-dependent polyneuropathy with chronic hyperglycemia and no macules.

entities.name: Granuloma Annulare
entities.description: Non-scaly annular erythematous plaques with preserved light touch and sweating.

entities.name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
entities.description: Autoimmune disease with photosensitive malar rash, positive ANA, and intact sensation.

entities.name: Secondary Syphilis
entities.description: Papulosquamous rash on palms and soles with reactive treponemal tests and intact sensation.

entities.name: Neurofibromatosis Type 1
entities.description: Neurocutaneous disorder with café-au-lait spots and soft dermal neurofibromas.

entities.name: Pityriasis Alba
entities.description: Hypopigmented scaly facial patches in atopic individuals with normal sensation.

entities.name: Erythema Nodosum
entities.description: Tender pretibial subcutaneous nodules restricted to lower limbs with no bacilli.

entities.name: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease
entities.description: Hereditary motor-sensory neuropathy with symmetric wasting, pes cavus, and family history.

entities.name: Post-Inflammatory Hypopigmentation
entities.description: Secondary pigmentary loss following dermatitis with normal cutaneous sensation.

entities.name: Mycosis Fungoides
entities.description: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with pruritic plaques, atypical lymphocytes, and normal nerves.

entities.name: Vasculitic Mononeuritis Multiplex
entities.description: Systemic vasculitis with multi-nerve palsies, positive ANCA, and no skin anesthesia.

entities.name: Amyloid Neuropathy
entities.description: Infiltrative neuropathy with autonomic failure and cardiomyopathy lacking macules.

entities.name: Diffuse Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Lepromatoid nodules teeming with Leishmania amastigotes with preserved sensation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, polar form, high resistance
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Presents at the high-resistance polar end with solitary or few (1–3) sharply demarcated, hypopigmented or erythematous scaly plaques showing prominent elevated outer margins, central clearing, complete anesthesia, alopecia, and anhidrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, borderline form, satellite lesions
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with 4 to 10 asymmetrical, well-demarcated anesthetic plaques often surrounded by smaller characteristic satellite macules, accompanied by irregular and prominent thickening of adjacent peripheral nerves.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, intermediate form, swiss-cheese plaques
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Presents with dimorphous annular erythematous plaques featuring characteristic punched-out hypochromic central areas and sloping, fading outer borders yielding a pathognomonic swiss-cheese or inverted-saucer morphology.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, multibacillary form, partial anesthesia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Presents with numerous, poorly defined, bilateral erythematous macules, papules, and infiltrated plaques distributed across the torso and limbs with variable or partial sensory impairment.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, anergic polar form, lepromas
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Represents the anergic multibacillary polar form with widespread, symmetrical, shiny hypochromic macules, diffuse dermal infiltration, and innumerable erythematous or copper-colored dermal nodules (lepromas).

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, early stage, hypochromic macules
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Represents the earliest transient clinical stage presenting with one or few ill-defined hypopigmented flat macules with faint sensory diminution, preserved sweating, and no detectable nerve trunk thickening.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, neuritic form, primary neuropathy
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Presents as primary neurological involvement in the total absence of cutaneous skin lesions, characterized by mononeuritis or mononeuritis multiplex with pain, sensory loss, and palpable peripheral nerve enlargement.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, histoid variant, keloid nodules
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Variant of lepromatous leprosy presenting with firm, circumscribed, succulent, keloid-like or fibroma-like cutaneous nodules and plaques arising over normal-appearing skin, containing spindle-shaped histiocytes packed with bacilli.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, diffuse lepromatous, waxy infiltration
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Diffuse non-nodular lepromatous variant characterized by generalized, shiny, waxy dermal infiltration, complete absence of discrete nodules, generalized alopecia, and diffuse anhydrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, necrotizing vasculopathy, purpuric ulceration
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe necrotizing cutaneous vasculopathy arising in Lucio or lepromatous leprosy marked by painful, purpuric, jagged geometric cutaneous infarctions leading to extensive ulceration and secondary sepsis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, reversal reaction, acute neuritis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Acute delayed-type (Type IV) hypersensitivity reaction in borderline patients causing sudden erythema, swelling, and desquamation of pre-existing skin plaques combined with excruciating acute peripheral neuritis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, type 2 reaction, immune complex vasculitis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Type 2 immune complex-mediated (Type III) hypersensitivity vasculitis in multibacillary patients causing recurrent crops of intensely painful erythematous subcutaneous nodules, high fever, and systemic organ inflammation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, silent neuropathy, painless denervation
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Insidious, asymptomatic deterioration of motor and sensory peripheral nerve function in the absence of spontaneous nerve pain or tenderness, frequently causing unnoticed permanent neurological deficits.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute neuritis, nerve pain
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Acute inflammatory swelling of peripheral nerve trunks within unyielding fibro-osseous canals, presenting with intense lancinating pain, severe localized tenderness, and rapid drop in sensorimotor capacity.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, neuropathic pain, dysesthesia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Long-standing persistent burning, tingling, or lancinating dysesthesias resulting from irreversible intraneural fibrosis, axonopathy, and central sensitization following leprous nerve destruction.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, nasal mucosal atrophy, crusting
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Bacillary infiltration and autonomic denervation of the nasal mucosa causing chronic crusting, foul-smelling nasal discharge, mucosal pallor, decreased vascularity, and progressive mucosal atrophy.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, septal perforation, cartilage necrosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Extensive lepromatous infiltration of the subperichondrium of the cartilaginous nasal septum resulting in avascular ischemic necrosis, septal perforation, and structural collapse.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, testicular inflammation, gonadal invasion
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Hematogenous bacillary invasion and immune-complex deposition in the testes during lepromatous disease and ENL, causing acute painful testicular swelling followed by parenchymal fibrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, hypogonadism, gonadal atrophy
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Progressive bilateral testicular shrinkage and destruction of androgen-producing Leydig cells and seminiferous tubules, culminating in primary hypogonadism, impotence, and azoospermia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, endocrine dysfunction, breast enlargement
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Symmetrical glandular breast enlargement in male lepromatous patients caused by endocrine dysfunction, altered estrogen-to-androgen ratios, and primary testicular failure.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, anterior uveitis, ocular involvement
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Granulomatous anterior uveitis caused by direct M. leprae invasion of the ciliary body and iris, producing miliary iris pearls, posterior synechiae, secondary glaucoma, and blindness.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, corneal ulceration, lagophthalmos complication
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe corneal desiccation, epithelial erosion, and secondary bacterial keratitis resulting from the inability to close the eyelids due to zygomatic branch facial nerve palsy.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, ocular inflammation, episcleral congestion
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Acute sectoral or diffuse inflammation of the episcleral tissue occurring frequently during systemic Type 2 ENL episodes, producing intense ocular pain, photophobia, and ciliary injection.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, trigeminal neuropathy, sensory loss
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Blunting or complete absence of the corneal protective blink reflex caused by leprous destruction of the ophthalmic division sensory fibers of the trigeminal cranial nerve.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, glomerulonephritis, immune complex disease
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Renal involvement arising during severe Type 2 reactional states driven by circulating bacillary antigen-antibody immune complexes depositing in glomerular basement membranes.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, systemic amyloidosis, chronic complications
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Systemic deposition of amyloid A fibrillar protein in kidneys, spleen, and liver secondary to prolonged, chronic suppurative ulcers and recurrent ENL inflammatory reactions.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, liver granuloma, reticuloendothelial seeding
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Asymptomatic miliary granulomatous infiltration of liver parenchyma and Kupffer cells by M. leprae, characterized by histiocytic clusters containing acid-fast bacilli in lepromatous patients.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, splenic enlargement, reticuloendothelial proliferation
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Non-tender enlargement of the spleen caused by extensive reticuloendothelial bacillary seeding, macrophage phagocytosis of mycobacterial debris, and secondary amyloidosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, marrow infiltration, bacillemia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Infiltration of the hematopoietic marrow by bacilli-laden Virchow histiocytes during persistent multibacillary bacteremia, contributing to secondary normocytic anemia and leukopenia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, lymphadenopathy, lymphatic dissemination
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Painless, discrete, rubbery enlargement of peripheral lymph nodes draining affected cutaneous territories, including epitrochlear, axillary, and inguinal lymph node chains.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, autonomic denervation, anhidrosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Localized or regional loss of sweat secretion within skin lesions caused by postganglionic sympathetic autonomic fiber destruction supplying eccrine sweat glands.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, follicular destruction, alopecia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Complete loss of vellus and terminal hair within cutaneous plaques and over limbs resulting from leprous denervation and destructive infiltration of pilosebaceous units.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, lymphatic obstruction, acral edema
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Chronic brawny non-pitting swelling of hands, forearms, lower legs, and feet caused by lymphatic vessel obliteration, recurrent erysipelas, and dependent vasomotor paralysis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, xerosis, autonomic denervation
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Dry, scaly, polygonally cracked, ichthyosis-like xerotic skin changes especially over the pretibial surfaces and distal limbs due to extensive autonomic denervation and sebaceous gland atrophy.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, trophic ulceration, neuropathic foot
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Development of deep, chronic, painless plantar ulcers over high-pressure weight-bearing zones of the foot following posterior tibial nerve sensory loss and unperceived repetitive trauma.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, bone resorption, phalangeal shortening
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Progressive, painless trophic absorption, shortening, and resorption of phalangeal bones of fingers and toes secondary to repeated microtrauma, secondary osteomyelitis, and autonomic ischemia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, digit inflammation, type 2 reaction
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Painful, spindle-shaped, inflammatory fusiform swelling of the fingers and toes caused by acute periosteal and soft-tissue inflammation during severe Type 2 reactional flares.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, reactive arthritis, synovial inflammation
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Symmetrical polyarthritis and tenosynovitis involving wrists, metacarpophalangeal joints, and ankles occurring as a major clinical component of Type 2 immune-complex reactions.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, laryngeal stridor, airway compromise
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Life-threatening inspiratory stridor and dyspnea caused by extensive lepromatous infiltration and acute inflammatory edema of the epiglottis, arytenoids, and vocal cords.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, dysautonomia, vasomotor dysfunction
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Impairment of sympathetic microvascular regulation leading to cyanotic cold extremities, postural hypotension, loss of vascular tone, and abnormal peripheral circulation in advanced disease.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, cardinal sign, sensory loss
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Solitary or multiple hypopigmented or erythematous skin lesions showing definitive, objective impairment or total absence of thermal, tactile, and pinprick sensation constitutes the primary cardinal WHO diagnostic hallmark.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, peripheral nerve enlargement, ulnar nerve
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Palpable, firm, cord-like or spindle-shaped thickening and exquisite tenderness of the ulnar nerve trunk directly above the medial epicondyle and olecranon groove.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, peroneal nerve, fibular neck
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Palpably thickened, enlarged, and rolled peripheral nerve trunk palpable as it winds around the neck of the fibula, predisposing to peroneal nerve palsy.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, cervical nerve, great auricular nerve
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Prominently visible and palpable thickened nerve trunk running diagonally across the sternocleidomastoid muscle in the lateral neck when the patient rotates the head.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, posterior tibial nerve, medial malleolus
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Palpable cord-like enlargement and tenderness of the posterior tibial nerve trunk as it passes posterior and inferior to the medial malleolus at the ankle.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, superficial radial nerve, anatomical snuffbox
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Palpable, superficial tender thickening of the sensory branch of the radial nerve crossing the anatomical snuffbox over the distal radius.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, median nerve, wrist
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Palpable firm swelling and enlargement of the median nerve trunk in the lower forearm just proximal to the flexor retinaculum of the wrist.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, facies leontina, lion-like facies
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Advanced lepromatous hallmark characterized by deep furrowing, massive infiltration of forehead and cheeks, and nodular coarsening producing a distinctive lion-like facial appearance.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, madarosis, eyebrow loss
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Symmetrical thinning and complete bilateral loss of eyebrows (beginning laterally) and eyelashes due to direct M. leprae destruction of facial hair follicles.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, main en griffe, ulnar claw hand
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Classic neuropathic hand deformity with hyperextension of the metacarpophalangeal joints and acute flexion of interphalangeal joints in the 4th and 5th digits from intrinsic muscle paralysis.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, facial nerve palsy, incomplete eyelid closure
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Inability to achieve complete voluntary closure of the palpebral fissure due to orbicularis oculi paralysis from zygomatic branch facial nerve destruction, exposing the cornea.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, common peroneal palsy, steppage gait
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Inability to dorsiflex the foot and toes due to common peroneal motor nerve palsy, causing a high-steppage gait with dragging of the toes during ambulation.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, nasal bridge collapse, saddle nose
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Depressed nasal bridge and collapse of the cartilaginous nose resulting from lepromatous osteochondritis, mucosal destruction, and septal cartilage absorption.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, earlobe infiltration, pendulous lobules
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Elongated, thickened, boggy, and hanging lobules of the external ears caused by diffuse histiocytic infiltration and bacillary accumulation in cooler ear tissue.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, thenar atrophy, ape hand
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Severe flattening of the thenar eminence with external rotation and inability to oppose or abduct the thumb due to chronic median motor nerve destruction.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, radial nerve palsy, wrist drop
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Inability to extend the wrist, thumb, and metacarpophalangeal joints caused by radial motor nerve paralysis, seen in advanced triple-nerve upper limb palsy.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, ulnar motor wasting, hypothenar atrophy
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Prominent hollow depression, flattening, and wasting of the intrinsic muscles of the hypothenar eminence resulting from ulnar nerve motor denervation.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, dorsal interosseous wasting, first web space
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Deep guttering and atrophy of the first dorsal interosseous muscle between the metacarpals of the thumb and index finger, pathognomonic of ulnar motor neuropathy.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, claw toes, intrinsic foot denervation
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Marked hyperextension of metatarsophalangeal joints and flexion of interphalangeal joints of the toes caused by denervation of intrinsic foot muscles by the posterior tibial nerve.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, mal perforant, plantar neuropathic ulcer
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Deep, round, calloused, and indolent trophic ulceration on the plantar aspect of the metatarsal heads or heel occurring in the setting of complete plantar anesthesia.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, corneal scarring, visual impairment
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Progressive haziness, vascularization, and scarring of the cornea resulting from unprotected exposure keratitis, trichiasis, or chronic interstitial keratitis.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, iris pearls, ocular granulomas
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Tiny, discrete, glistening, white miliary granulomatous nodules lining the pupillary margin of the iris, pathognomonic of lepromatous intraocular bacillary spread.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, ectropion, eyelid eversion
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Outward sagging and eversion of the lower eyelid caused by paralytic atony of the orbicularis oculi and cutaneous cicatrization, leading to constant epiphora.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, inflammatory nodules, erythema nodosum leprosum
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Eruption of multiple, evanescent, exquisitely painful erythematous subcutaneous lumps and plaques across the extensor limbs, face, and trunk in Type 2 reactions.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, inverted saucer plaque, foveal lesion
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Characteristically shaped annular plaques with a sharply defined punched-out hypochromic central zone and sloping erythematous outer margin diagnostic of mid-borderline leprosy.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, satellite lesions, borderline tuberculoid
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Small, distinct, anesthetic macular or papular lesions clustered immediately adjacent to the margin of a larger dominant anesthetic plaque in borderline tuberculoid leprosy.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, atrophic wrinkling, epidermal thinning
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Thin, atrophic, dry, non-sweating epidermal wrinkling resembling fine cigarette paper over the central healing area of resolving tuberculoid plaques.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, high-steppage gait, peroneal palsy gait
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Exaggerated hip and knee flexion lifting the leg high off the ground during ambulation to prevent the dropped, flaccid foot from scraping the floor.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, slit-skin smear, acid-fast bacilli
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Microscopic demonstration of slender, rod-shaped acid-alcohol-resistant bacilli stained red with modified Ziehl-Neelsen or Fite-Faraco technique on dermal slit smears.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, bacteriological index, bacillary load
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Logarithmic quantification scale (0 to 6+) measuring bacillary density across 4 to 6 cooler anatomical slit sites, with BI >= 1+ definitively classifying multibacillary disease.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, globi, foamy histiocytes
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Dense spherical aggregates and parallel cigarette-pack clusters of M. leprae bacilli densely packed inside foamy histiocytes on slit-skin smear or biopsy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, morphological index, bacillary viability
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Percentage assessment of solid, uniformly stained viable bacilli relative to fragmented and granular non-viable forms, serving as an index of therapeutic response.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, nerve ultrasound, neuromuscular POCUS
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Bedside sonography demonstrating marked, asymmetrical nerve trunk swelling, disruption of fascicular echo-architecture, and hypoechoic endoneurial thickening.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, nerve cross-sectional area, sonographic enlargement
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Sonographic cross-sectional area enlargement of the ulnar nerve exceeding 10–12 mm² at the elbow or peroneal nerve at the fibular neck, indicating leprous neuropathy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, Doppler hyperemia, acute neuritis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Prominent endoneurial and perineurial color Doppler signals demonstrating active intraneural hyperemia, a hallmark of acute neuritis and Type 1 reactional flares.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, sensory hierarchy, bedside examination
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Predictable chronological pattern of sensory modality degradation within cutaneous lesions: loss of temperature discrimination first, light touch second, and pinprick pain last.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, temperature discrimination, thermal loss
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Bedside sensory testing failure to differentiate between hot and cold water tubes applied to the skin lesion, representing the earliest sensitive physical sign of leprous neuropathy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, Semmes-Weinstein monofilament, light touch
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Inability to perceive Semmes-Weinstein 2.0g or 0.05g calibrated monofilament bristles on cutaneous lesions or distal palmar and plantar innervation territories.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, pinprick testing, nociceptive loss
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Blunted or absent perception of sharp pain upon sterile pinprick stimulation within the boundaries of hypopigmented or erythematous skin plaques.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, voluntary muscle testing, motor denervation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Standardized MRC motor grading reduction in abductor pollicis brevis, first dorsal interosseous, or tibialis anterior muscles documenting peripheral motor denervation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, Mitsuda reaction, lepromatous anergy
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Absence of delayed-type granulomatous induration at 28 days following intradermal lepromin injection (negative Mitsuda reaction), demonstrating lepromatous T-cell anergy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, positive Mitsuda reaction, tuberculoid immunity
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Strong delayed hypersensitivity induration (>5 mm at 28 days, positive Mitsuda reaction) demonstrating intact, protective cell-mediated immunity in tuberculoid disease.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, epithelioid granuloma, dermal nerve destruction
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Full-thickness skin biopsy showing compact, non-caseating epithelioid cell granulomas with Langhans giant cells tracking and destroying cutaneous neurovascular bundles.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, Virchow cells, foamy histiocytes
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Histopathology revealing diffuse dermal sheets of lipid-laden, multivacuolated foamy macrophages (Virchow cells) teeming with innumerable acid-fast bacilli.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, grenz zone, histopathology
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Characteristic histological subepidermal clear zone of normal uninvaded collagen separating the flattened epidermis from the dense lepromatous histiocytic dermal infiltrate.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, endoneurial fibrosis, nerve biopsy
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Severe endoneurial collagen deposition, perineurial lamellar thickening, and progressive destruction of Schwann cell architecture visualized on nerve biopsy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, anti-PGL-1, serology
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Elevated circulating serum IgM antibodies specifically directed against M. leprae phenolic glycolipid-1 antigen, strongly correlated with high bacteriological indices.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, ML-Flow test, point-of-care serology
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Rapid bedside point-of-care immunochromatographic visual band confirming high titers of anti-PGL-1 antibodies, triaging patients directly into the multibacillary category.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, RLEP PCR, molecular diagnostics
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Molecular amplification of the highly repetitive RLEP genomic insertion sequence from skin biopsy, slit smear, or nasal swab confirming mycobacterial DNA presence.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, neutrophilia, toxic left shift
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Complete blood count showing marked leukocytosis (WBC 15,000–25,000/µL) with prominent left shift and toxic granulation during acute Type 2 ENL episodes.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated ESR, acute phase reactants
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Marked elevation of the erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR >80–120 mm/h) reflecting intense systemic immune-complex inflammatory activity in ENL.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated CRP, systemic vasculitis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Sharp rise in serum C-reactive protein (CRP >50–150 mg/L) serving as an objective biochemical marker of systemic vasculitis and reactional severity.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, proteinuria, glomerulonephritis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Detection of significant urinary protein excretion (>1–3 g/24h) reflecting secondary immune-complex deposition glomerulonephritis during recurrent ENL attacks.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hematuria, RBC casts
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Urinalysis demonstrating dysmorphic red blood cells and red cell casts indicating active glomerular inflammation in leprosy reactional states.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normocytic anemia, chronic inflammation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Hematological profile showing normocytic normochromic anemia of chronic disease and reticuloendothelial iron sequestration in advanced lepromatous patients.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hypergammaglobulinemia, protein electrophoresis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum protein electrophoresis revealing a broad-based polyclonal increase in gamma globulins with an inverted albumin-to-globulin ratio in multibacillary disease.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, false-positive VDRL, antiphospholipid antibodies
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Positive non-treponemal syphilis serology (VDRL or RPR) with negative specific treponemal tests (FTA-ABS) due to cross-reacting anti-phospholipid antibodies in LL.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, TNF-alpha, systemic cytokines
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Markedly elevated circulating serum levels of TNF-alpha correlating with systemic pro-inflammatory toxicity, fever, and tissue damage during ENL reactions.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, IL-6 elevation, immune complex vasculitis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Elevated circulating IL-6 concentrations reflecting robust Th2-mediated B-cell activation and systemic immune complex-driven vasculitis in Type 2 reactions.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, low testosterone, Leydig cell destruction
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Subnormal total and bioavailable serum testosterone levels resulting from primary destruction of testicular Leydig cells by lepromatous orchitis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated LH, hypergonadotropic hypogonadism
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Compensatory pituitary hypersecretion of LH and FSH (hypergonadotropic hypogonadism) in response to primary lepromatous testicular gonadal failure.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, acro-osteolysis, plain radiograph
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Plain skeletal radiographs showing progressive tapering, cortical thinning, and pencil-pointing resorption of the distal phalanges and metatarsal heads.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, soft tissue resorption, digital shortening
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Radiographic demonstration of concentric concentric digital shortening and total loss of terminal phalangeal soft tissue tufts from repeated painless microtrauma.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, nerve conduction velocity, electromyography
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Electromyography showing marked slowing of motor and sensory conduction velocities and prolonged distal latencies across thickened peripheral nerve segments.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, reduced SNAP, axonal neuropathy
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Absent or severely attenuated sensory nerve action potential (SNAP) amplitudes in the ulnar, median, or sural nerves demonstrating axonal sensory loss.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, cold nerve abscess, intraneural necrosis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Identification of focal hypoechoic, fluid-filled cold nerve abscess cavities and caseous necrosis within the peripheral nerve trunk on neuromuscular sonography.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, household contact, multibacillary case
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Prolonged, intimate cohabitation with an untreated index multibacillary leprosy patient who discharges millions of viable bacilli from the upper respiratory tract.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, droplet inhalation, respiratory transmission
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Respiratory inhalation of infectious droplets and dried nasal mucosal secretions expelled during coughing and sneezing by untreated multibacillary patients.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, armadillo reservoir, zoonotic exposure
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Direct zoonotic contact, hunting, butchering, skinning, or consumption of wild nine-banded armadillos (Dasypus novemcinctus), natural hosts of M. leprae in the Americas.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, red squirrel, zoonotic reservoir
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Sylvatic exposure to wild Eurasian red squirrels (Sciurus vulgaris) in the British Isles, which harbor endemic clinical M. leprae and M. lepromatosis infections.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, primate reservoir, zoonosis
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Zoonotic contact with naturally infected non-human primates, including chimpanzees and sooty mangabeys, which serve as animal reservoirs of M. leprae in Africa.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, cutaneous inoculation, skin microtrauma
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Percutaneous entry of bacilli via preexisting cutaneous abrasions, skin trauma, or contaminated sharp instruments in close proximity to infected cases.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, tropical endemicity, developing country
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Long-term residence, migration, or extended travel in tropical and subtropical countries where sustained domestic transmission of M. leprae persists.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, South-East Asia, global burden
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Residence in the WHO South-East Asia region, primarily India and Indonesia, which accounts for greater than 70% of all newly diagnosed leprosy cases globally.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, household crowding, socioeconomic deprivation
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Substandard socioeconomic living conditions and overcrowded, poorly ventilated domestic environments that maximize continuous respiratory droplet exposure.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, pediatric risk, sentinel indicator
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Children under 15 years living in household contact with untreated patients, representing a high-risk cohort and sentinel indicator of active local transmission.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, prolonged latency, paucibacillary
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Paucibacillary leprosy exhibits an extraordinarily prolonged average incubation period of 3 to 5 years before the appearance of initial anesthetic macules.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, multibacillary latency, 20-year incubation
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Multibacillary leprosy exhibits an exceptionally long incubation latency spanning 5 to 10 years, and occasionally extending up to 20 years before diagnosis.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, host genetics, innate immunity
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Inherited host susceptibility driven by genomic variations in PRKN, PACRG, MRC1, NOD2, RIPK2, and LRRK2 genes controlling innate macrophage defenses.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, HLA-DR2, tuberculoid susceptibility
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Individuals expressing human leukocyte antigen class II alleles HLA-DR2 and HLA-DR3 possess significant immunological predisposition toward tuberculoid leprosy.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, HLA-DQ1, lepromatous susceptibility
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Individuals expressing the human leukocyte antigen class II allele HLA-DQ1 exhibit pronounced genetic susceptibility to anergic lepromatous leprosy.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, PARK2 polymorphisms, PACRG
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Single-nucleotide polymorphisms in the co-regulated PARK2 and PACRG promoter region impair macrophage ubiquitin-proteasome responses to M. leprae infection.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, MRC1 polymorphisms, mannose receptor
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Genetic polymorphisms in exon 7 of the MRC1 gene encoding the macrophage mannose receptor increase host vulnerability to multibacillary disease.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, natural resistance, low attack rate
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Over 95% of human populations possess innate genetic immunity and cell-mediated resistance, remaining completely healthy and asymptomatic upon exposure.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, contact screening, SDR-PEP
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Omission of single-dose rifampicin post-exposure prophylaxis (SDR-PEP) among documented household and close social contacts increases subsequent clinical attack rates.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, pregnancy, postpartum reaction
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Gestational immunomodulation and rapid postpartum cell-mediated rebound frequently unmask latent leprosy or precipitate severe Type 1 and Type 2 reactional flares.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, immunosuppressive biologics, anti-TNF therapy
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Patients receiving systemic anti-TNF biologic agents, immunosuppressants, or prolonged corticosteroid regimens can experience accelerated reactivation of latent infection.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, subclinical carriage, nasal reservoir
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Asymptomatic household contacts harboring M. leprae DNA in nasal swabs act as transient subclinical carriers and community reservoirs for disease transmission.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, preserved temperature sensation, exclusion boundary
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Finding completely normal and preserved thermal discrimination (cold vs. warm) within a solitary skin lesion definitively rules out tuberculoid and borderline leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, normal light touch, preserved sensation
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Normal, preserved light touch sensation using Semmes-Weinstein monofilaments across all boundaries of an isolated cutaneous patch rules out leprosy plaques.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, pruritus, itching dermatosis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Presence of intense itching, scratching, or excoriated dermatitis within skin lesions rules out typical leprosy patches, which are non-pruritic and anesthetic.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, acute onset, rapid evolution
