relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapid explosive onset and progression of cutaneous lesions or peripheral neuropathy over days to weeks firmly rules out the indolent multi-year course of leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, normal nerve caliber, absence of hypertrophy
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Complete absence of peripheral nerve trunk thickening, tenderness, or cross-sectional enlargement on exam and ultrasound rules out primary pure neural leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, preserved sweating, intact hair follicles
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Normal eccrine sweating response and intact follicular hair growth inside an isolated hypopigmented macule rules out denervating tuberculoid leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, symmetric polyneuropathy, metabolic neuropathy
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Strictly symmetrical, length-dependent distal stocking-glove sensory polyneuropathy without cutaneous anesthetic macules or palpable nerve trunks rules out leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, beta-lactam response, intrinsic resistance
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapid clinical healing and clearance of skin lesions in response to standard beta-lactams or third-generation cephalosporins firmly rules out M. leprae infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, scabies burrows, excoriated web spaces
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Identification of intensely itchy serpiginous web-space burrows with nocturnal exacerbation characteristic of Sarcoptes scabiei infestation rules out leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, acute necrosis, pyoderma gangrenosum
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Acute spontaneous purulent breakdown and rapidly progressing central ulceration over several days rules out slowly evolving granulomatous leprosy lesions.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, transient rash, urticarial eruption
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Evanescent or migratory erythematous wheals and plaques that spontaneously resolve within 24 to 48 hours without scarring rule out chronic leprous lesions.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, negative slit smears, lepromatous exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Repeatedly negative slit-skin smears at multiple cool peripheral sites (earlobes, elbows, active margins) firmly rules out lepromatous and borderline lepromatous leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, oral aphthae, Behcet disease
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Recurrent, painful, self-limiting oral aphthous ulcerations typical of Behçet syndrome or Crohn disease rules out standard oral leprosy involvement.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, preserved corneal reflex, Bell palsy
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Fully preserved, normal bilateral corneal touch reflexes in an isolated peripheral facial palsy rules out trigeminal nerve involvement of leprosy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, absent nerve hypertrophy, non-leprous mononeuritis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Absolute lack of palpable nerve trunk thickening in the ulnar, common peroneal, posterior tibial, and great auricular nerves rules out leprous mononeuritis multiplex.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, penicillin response, bacterial cellulitis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapid defervescence and resolution of tender inflammatory cutaneous nodules within 24–48 hours of penicillin therapy excludes Type 2 ENL reactions.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, fungal hyphae, KOH positivity
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Microscopic detection of branching fungal hyphae or budding yeast clusters on skin scraping potassium hydroxide (KOH) examination rules out leprosy patches.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, normal nerve sonography, intact fascicles
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] High-resolution neuromuscular ultrasound demonstrating preserved endoneurial fascicular architecture and normal cross-sectional areas rules out active leprous neuritis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, target lesions, erythema multiforme major
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Acute self-limited concentric three-zone targetoid skin lesions with mucosal involvement characteristic of erythema multiforme major rules out leprosy reactions.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, acute flaccid paralysis, anterior horn disease
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Sudden painless flaccid limb paralysis developing over 24 to 48 hours without preceding sensory impairment rules out chronic leprous mononeuritis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, normal reflexes, preserved sensation
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Normal, brisk deep tendon reflexes combined with preserved light touch and pinprick sensation in an extremity rules out advanced leprous sensorimotor neuropathy.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, hypopigmented macules
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Completely depigmented chalk-white macules in vitiligo retain intact thermal and light touch sensation, normal hair follicles, preserved sweating, and lack enlarged nerves.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, superficial mycosis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Superficial fine-scaling hypopigmented patches in pityriasis versicolor feature intact sensation, normal peripheral nerves, and characteristic fungal hyphae on KOH prep.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, protozoal ulcer
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Volcano-like indurated ulcerations in cutaneous leishmaniasis maintain fully intact local tactile sensation, spare peripheral nerve trunks, and show Leishmania amastigotes on smear.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, non-caseating granuloma
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Sarcoid granulomatous dermal plaques feature intact cutaneous sensation, normal nerve trunks, elevated serum ACE, and bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy on chest imaging.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, lupus vulgaris
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Lupus vulgaris plaques display apple-jelly nodules on diascopy with completely preserved tactile sensation, no peripheral nerve involvement, and positive tuberculin skin test.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, metabolic polyneuropathy
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Diabetic peripheral polyneuropathy is strictly symmetrical and length-dependent, correlates with chronic hyperglycemia, and lacks cutaneous anesthetic macules or focal nerve thickening.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, annular plaques
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Non-scaly annular dermal plaques of granuloma annulare maintain completely preserved light touch and pinprick sensation, normal eccrine sweating, and normal peripheral nerves.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, autoimmune connective tissue disease
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Malar photosensitive rash in systemic lupus erythematosus maintains intact sensation, normal peripheral nerve caliber, positive anti-dsDNA/ANA antibodies, and multisystem flares.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, spirochetal infection
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Papulosquamous copper-colored rash in secondary syphilis involves palms and soles with intact cutaneous sensation, generalized adenopathy, and reactive treponemal serology.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, neurocutaneous syndrome
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Neurofibromatosis presents with soft, compressible, painless dermal neurofibromas and café-au-lait macules without loss of thermal sensation or bacillary infiltration.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, atopic dermatosis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Ill-defined hypopigmented dry facial patches in young atopic patients preserve intact thermal and fine tactile sensation, normal sweating, and normal peripheral nerves.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, septal panniculitis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Idiopathic erythema nodosum produces tender pretibial nodules restricted to lower legs, resolving without ulceration over 3–6 weeks, and lacks slit-skin acid-fast bacilli.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, hereditary neuropathy
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Hereditary motor-sensory neuropathy produces symmetric distal wasting, pes cavus, and hammer toes with strong family history, lacking anesthetic skin macules.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, post-inflammatory dermatosis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Hypopigmented macules following prior burns or dermatitis retain completely normal thermal and light touch perception, intact sweating, and unaffected nerve trunks.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, cutaneous lymphoma
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma plaques present with poikiloderma, intense intractable pruritus, atypical epidermotropic lymphocytes on biopsy, and normal nerve trunks.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, systemic necrotizing vasculitis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Systemic vasculitides like polyarteritis nodosa produce acute painful multi-nerve palsies with systemic constitutional signs, positive ANCA, and normal skin sensation outside deficits.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, systemic amyloid neuropathy
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Familial or AL amyloid neuropathy presents with autonomic failure and restrictive cardiomyopathy, lacking focal hypopigmented anesthetic skin macules or bacillary globi.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, diffuse leishmanoid plaques
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Diffuse lepromatoid nodules in diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis maintain preserved cutaneous tactile sensation, normal nerve trunks, and show Leishmania amastigotes on smear.

entities.name: Leptospirosis
entities.description: Life-threatening biphasic zoonotic spirochetal infection caused by pathogenic Leptospira species, characterized by acute septicemic bacteremia followed by immune-mediated multi-organ dysfunction, severe icteric Weil disease, or catastrophic pulmonary hemorrhage.

entities.name: Biphasic Febrile Illness
entities.description: Classic two-phase clinical evolution comprising an acute bacteremic leptospiremic phase followed by an immune phase.

entities.name: Anicteric Leptospirosis
entities.description: Mild non-jaundiced presentation accounting for the large majority of symptomatic infections.

entities.name: Icteric Leptospirosis
entities.description: Severe icteric variant characterized by jaundice, renal failure, and hemorrhagic complications.

entities.name: Weil Disease Triad
entities.description: Pathognomonic severe clinical triad of jaundice, acute renal failure, and hemorrhagic diathesis.

entities.name: Pulmonary Hemorrhage Syndrome
entities.description: Catastrophic intra-alveolar hemorrhage presenting with acute dyspnea, hemoptysis, and hypoxic failure.

entities.name: Acute Kidney Injury
entities.description: Acute renal failure secondary to toxic tubulointerstitial nephritis and acute tubular necrosis.

entities.name: Non-Oliguric Renal Failure
entities.description: Initial phase of renal injury with preserved urine output and tubular electrolyte wasting.

entities.name: Oliguric Renal Failure
entities.description: Late progression of severe tubular necrosis with urine output dropping below 400 mL per day.

entities.name: Aseptic Meningitis
entities.description: Secondary immune-phase central nervous system inflammation with lymphocytic CSF pleocytosis.

entities.name: Acute Myocarditis
entities.description: Spirochete-induced myocardial interstitial inflammation presenting with arrhythmias and cardiac dysfunction.

entities.name: Acute Pancreatitis
entities.description: Ischemic and inflammatory acinar necrosis causing severe epigastric pain and hyperenzymemia.

entities.name: Severe Hemoptysis
entities.description: Coughing of frank blood arising from extensive capillary bleeding into alveolar spaces.

entities.name: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome
entities.description: Rapid non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema and alveolar collapse triggered by capillary leak.

entities.name: Subconjunctival Hemorrhage
entities.description: Prominent flame-shaped extravasation of blood beneath the bulbar conjunctival membrane.

entities.name: Anterior Uveitis
entities.description: Late immune-mediated inflammation of the iris and ciliary body weeks to months after acute infection.

entities.name: Panuveitis
entities.description: Extensive intraocular inflammation involving anterior, intermediate, and posterior ocular segments.

entities.name: Abrupt High Fever
entities.description: Sudden dramatic temperature elevation reaching 39 to 40 degrees Celsius during initial spirochetemia.

entities.name: Rigors and Chills
entities.description: Violent shaking rigors accompanying explosive bacteremic dissemination.

entities.name: Incapacitating Frontal Headache
entities.description: Intense, unremitting bitemporal and retro-orbital cephalalgia resistant to standard analgesia.

entities.name: Photophobia
entities.description: Painful intolerance to ambient light associated with ciliary congestion and meningeal irritation.

entities.name: Intense Lumbar Myalgia
entities.description: Disproportionate tenderness and pain localized to paraspinal lumbar musculature.

entities.name: Acute Rhabdomyolysis
entities.description: Skeletal muscle necrosis causing massive release of myoglobin and marked creatine kinase elevation.

entities.name: Diffuse Petechial Eruption
entities.description: Non-blanching pinpoint cutaneous hemorrhages reflecting microvascular vasculitis and thrombocytopenia.

entities.name: Cutaneous Ecchymoses
entities.description: Extensive confluent subcutaneous hemorrhages and bruising in severe icteric disease.

entities.name: Epistaxis
entities.description: Spontaneous nasal mucosal bleeding arising from severe thrombocytopenia and vascular damage.

entities.name: Gastrointestinal Bleeding
entities.description: Upper and lower digestive tract hemorrhage including hematemesis, melena, and hematochezia.

entities.name: Acalculous Cholecystitis
entities.description: Ischemic and inflammatory gallbladder inflammation in the absence of gallstones.

entities.name: Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Enlarged and tender liver edge reflecting canalicular cholestasis and reticuloendothelial activation.

entities.name: Splenomegaly
entities.description: Palpable splenic enlargement resulting from systemic reticuloendothelial response.

entities.name: Hypotensive Shock
entities.description: Distributive and hypovolemic circulatory collapse driven by capillary leakage and vasodilation.

entities.name: Electrocardiographic Arrhythmias
entities.description: Cardiac rhythm disturbances including atrial fibrillation, flutter, and junctional rhythms.

entities.name: Atrioventricular Block
entities.description: Cardiac conduction system delay or block ranging from first-degree to complete heart block.

entities.name: Encephalopathy
entities.description: Altered mental status, confusion, and delirium resulting from multi-organ failure and cerebritis.

entities.name: Peripheral Neuropathy
entities.description: Motor and sensory peripheral nerve dysfunction developing during late immune-phase convalescence.

entities.name: Adrenal Hemorrhage
entities.description: Bilateral hemorrhagic necrosis of adrenal glands provoking acute vascular collapse.

entities.name: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation
entities.description: Systemic microvascular thrombosis and consumptive coagulopathy in advanced multi-organ failure.

entities.name: Gross Hematuria
entities.description: Macroscopic hematuria resulting from severe renal papillary necrosis and glomerular injury.

entities.name: Hypovolemic Shock
entities.description: Severe intravascular volume depletion from vomiting, diaphoresis, and tubular solute wasting.

entities.name: Mesenteric Ischemia
entities.description: Microvascular thrombosis of mesenteric circulation causing acute ischemic bowel injury.

entities.name: Sensorineural Hearing Loss
entities.description: Acute or subacute auditory impairment triggered by immune-mediated cochlear microvasculitis.

entities.name: Conjunctival Suffusion
entities.description: Bilateral ciliary and bulbar conjunctival erythema devoid of purulent secretions or chemosis.

entities.name: Gastrocnemius Muscle Tenderness
entities.description: Excruciating, disproportionate tenderness elicited by gentle palpation of calf muscle bellies.

entities.name: Orange-Bronze Scleral Icterus
entities.description: Striking bronze-orange coloration of sclerae resulting from hyperbilirubinemia and capillary injection.

entities.name: Snowflake Hemoptysis
entities.description: Sudden coughing of bright red blood in patients with diffuse snowflake pulmonary infiltrates.

entities.name: Subconjunctival Ecchymosis
entities.description: Confluent flame-shaped collections of extravasated blood in the bulbar conjunctival space.

entities.name: Lumbar Paraspinal Tenderness
entities.description: Severe focal pain provoked by palpation of lumbar paraspinal muscle columns.

entities.name: Bilateral Ciliary Flush
entities.description: Circumcorneal violaceous vascular injection indicating deep ciliary vessel dilation.

entities.name: Nuchal Rigidity
entities.description: Involuntary neck stiffness and resistance on passive cervical flexion indicating meningism.

entities.name: Positive Kernig Sign
entities.description: Pain and hamstring resistance elicited upon knee extension with hip flexed at 90 degrees.

entities.name: Positive Brudzinski Sign
entities.description: Involuntary flexion of knees and hips provoked by passive anterior neck flexion.

entities.name: Tender Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Smooth liver enlargement extending below the right costal margin with exquisite palpation pain.

entities.name: Right Hypochondrial Tenderness
entities.description: Localized palpation tenderness in the right upper abdominal quadrant simulating acute cholecystitis.

entities.name: Palpable Splenic Tip
entities.description: Palpable splenomegaly extending 1 to 2 cm beneath the left subcostal margin.

entities.name: Purpuric Skin Lesions
entities.description: Non-blanching violaceous macules and palpable purpura distributed on dependent body surfaces.

entities.name: Petechial Palatal Enanthem
entities.description: Multiple pinpoint submucosal hemorrhages scattered over the soft palate and uvula.

entities.name: Peripheral Vasodilatory Shock
entities.description: Warm extremities with bounding peripheral pulses and widened pulse pressure transitioning to hypotension.

entities.name: Relative Bradycardia
entities.description: Pulse rate disproportionately low relative to the degree of core body temperature elevation.

entities.name: Third Heart Sound
entities.description: Low-frequency protodiastolic gallop sound audible at the apex indicating acute ventricular dilation.

entities.name: Pericardial Friction Rub
entities.description: Superficial scratchy three-component cardiac sound audible at the lower left sternal border.

entities.name: Bilateral Pulmonary Crackles
entities.description: Fine end-inspiratory crackles auscultated over mid and lower lung bases.

entities.name: Diffuse Bronchial Breath Sounds
entities.description: Harsh tubular breath sounds audible over consolidating lung regions in severe hemorrhage.

entities.name: Oliguria Below Threshold
entities.description: Monitored urinary output plummeting to under 0.5 mL/kg/h despite appropriate volume resuscitation.

entities.name: Gross Macroscopic Hematuria
entities.description: Visibly bloody or tea-colored urine draining into the urinary catheter collection bag.

entities.name: Tender Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Discrete, mobile, tender enlarged lymph nodes palpated in cervical and inguinal nodal stations.

entities.name: Marked Cutaneous Hyperesthesia
entities.description: Severe exaggerated cutaneous pain elicited by light tactile skin touch.

entities.name: Abdominal Rebound Tenderness
entities.description: Peritoneal irritation with sharp pain upon rapid release of manual abdominal pressure.

entities.name: Delirium and Confusion
entities.description: Acute fluctuating cognitive disorientation, visual hallucinations, and psychomotor agitation.

entities.name: Dorsalis Pedis Edema
entities.description: Bilateral dependent pitting edema of lower extremities and dorsum of feet.

entities.name: Marked Neutrophilic Leukocytosis
entities.description: Total peripheral WBC 12,000–25,000/µL with neutrophil fraction >80%, distinguishing from viral fevers.

entities.name: Prominent Bandemia Left Shift
entities.description: Peripheral blood smear revealing >10–15% immature unsegmented band forms and toxic granulation.

entities.name: Severe Leukemoid Reaction
entities.description: Extreme reactive white blood cell elevation exceeding 30,000 to 50,000/µL in Weil disease.

entities.name: Severe Thrombocytopenia
entities.description: Platelet count dropping below 100,000/µL, and frequently <50,000/µL in severe disease.

entities.name: Normocytic Normochromic Anemia
entities.description: Rapid drop in hemoglobin and hematocrit driven by microangiopathic hemolysis and blood loss.

entities.name: Marked Hyperbilirubinemia
entities.description: Total serum bilirubin markedly elevated (10–30 mg/dL) with direct fraction exceeding 60%.

entities.name: Mild Transaminase Elevation
entities.description: AST and ALT only modestly elevated (100–300 U/L, rarely >500 U/L) despite severe clinical jaundice.

entities.name: Elevated Alkaline Phosphatase
entities.description: Serum ALP elevated 2 to 5 times the upper limit of normal reflecting biliary canalicular injury.

entities.name: Marked Hyperamylasemia
entities.description: Serum amylase and lipase elevated >3 times normal without structural biliary stone obstruction.

entities.name: Rapid Azotemia Elevation
entities.description: Rapid steep increase in serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen out of proportion to muscle mass.

entities.name: Early Hypokalemia
entities.description: Serum potassium <3.5 mEq/L despite progressive azotemia in early non-oliguric AKI.

entities.name: Early Hyponatremia
entities.description: Serum sodium <130 mEq/L caused by impaired proximal tubular reabsorption and solute wasting.

entities.name: Severe Hypomagnesemia
entities.description: Serum magnesium <1.5 mg/dL resulting from tubular wasting of divalent cations.

entities.name: Markedly Elevated Creatine Kinase
entities.description: Total serum CK elevated 5 to 20 times the upper limit of normal reflecting extensive rhabdomyolysis.

entities.name: Extreme C-Reactive Protein
entities.description: Serum CRP markedly elevated, typically >100 to 250 mg/L, reflecting intense systemic vasculitis.

entities.name: Marked Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate
entities.description: ESR markedly accelerated (>60–100 mm/h) during the first week of infection.

entities.name: Active Urinary Sediment
entities.description: Urinalysis revealing proteinuria, microscopic hematuria, pyuria, and granular casts.

entities.name: Microscopic Pyuria
entities.description: Urine microscopy demonstrating 10–50 WBC/HPF with negative routine bacterial urine culture.

entities.name: Granular Casts in Urine
entities.description: Coarse brown granular and cellular casts on urine sediment microscopy confirming ATN.

entities.name: Prolonged Prothrombin Time
entities.description: INR >1.5 and prolonged PT resulting from hepatic cholestasis and coagulopathy.

entities.name: Elevated D-Dimer Levels
entities.description: Fibrin degradation products and D-dimers elevated >5-fold above normal.

entities.name: High Procalcitonin Levels
entities.description: Serum procalcitonin markedly elevated (>2 to 10 ng/mL) at initial hospital admission.

entities.name: CSF Lymphocytic Pleocytosis
entities.description: CSF analysis showing 50–500 WBC/µL with >80% lymphocytes during the immune phase.

entities.name: Elevated CSF Protein
entities.description: CSF protein concentration elevated to 50–150 mg/dL with normal glucose levels.

entities.name: Snowflake Alveolar Infiltrates
entities.description: Bilateral patchy snowflake or snowstorm alveolar opacities on chest radiography.

entities.name: Bilateral Ground-Glass Opacities
entities.description: High-resolution CT revealing extensive bilateral ground-glass attenuation and consolidation.

entities.name: Crazy-Paving Pattern
entities.description: Chest CT finding of ground-glass attenuation with thickened interlobular septa.

entities.name: Bilateral Sparing Apices
entities.description: Characteristic pulmonary distribution where alveolar infiltrates spare the apex and peripheral rim.

entities.name: Bilateral Nephromegaly on Ultrasound
entities.description: Sonographic finding of symmetrically enlarged kidneys with increased cortical echogenicity.

entities.name: Acalculous Gallbladder Wall Edema
entities.description: Ultrasound showing gallbladder wall thickening >4 mm without intraluminal calculi.

entities.name: Non-Dilated Biliary Ducts
entities.description: Sonographic demonstration of normal calipers of intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts.

entities.name: Bedside Lung Ultrasound B-Lines
entities.description: POCUS lung ultrasound revealing multiple confluent vertical B-lines indicating alveolar fluid.

entities.name: Subpleural Consolidation on POCUS
entities.description: Small hypoechoic peripheral consolidations with irregular pleural borders on lung ultrasound.

entities.name: Depressed Left Ventricular Function
entities.description: Bedside echocardiogram revealing diffuse hypokinesia and reduced ejection fraction <45%.

entities.name: Pericardial Effusion on Echo
entities.description: Transthoracic echocardiogram detecting small-to-moderate circumferential pericardial fluid.

entities.name: Prolonged PR Interval
entities.description: Electrocardiogram demonstrating first-degree atrioventricular block (>200 ms).

entities.name: Repolarization T-Wave Inversions
entities.description: ECG showing diffuse ST-segment depression and deep symmetrical T-wave inversions.

entities.name: Metabolic Acidosis
entities.description: Arterial blood gas showing high anion gap metabolic acidosis with serum bicarbonate <15 mEq/L.

entities.name: Contaminated Floodwaters
entities.description: Wading or swimming in urban floodwaters contaminated with urine from infected rodents.

entities.name: Rodent Urine Exposure
entities.description: Environmental contact with mud, wet soil, or food items contaminated with rodent urine.

entities.name: Agricultural Rice Farming
entities.description: Prolonged barefoot immersion in flooded rice paddy fields harboring rodent reservoirs.

entities.name: Sugarcane Harvesting Labor
entities.description: Manual harvesting of sugarcane in rodent-infested fields with frequent skin abrasions.

entities.name: Sewer Maintenance Work
entities.description: Occupational contact with raw municipal sewage and underground rodent habitats.

entities.name: Abattoir and Slaughterhouse Work
entities.description: Occupational exposure to animal fluids and tissues during livestock butchering.

entities.name: Freshwater Recreational Sports
entities.description: Water immersion during rafting, triathlon swimming, canoeing, or adventure racing.

entities.name: Urban Slum Habitation
entities.description: Residence in informal settlements with open sewers, poor drainage, and high rat densities.

entities.name: Veterinary Livestock Contact
entities.description: Handling infected cattle, pigs, or horses and their reproductive discharges.

entities.name: Breached Skin Inoculation
entities.description: Spirochetal entry through cuts, scratches, skin abrasions, or macerated wet skin.

entities.name: Permucosal Inoculation
entities.description: Invasion across intact or irritated mucous membranes of conjunctivae or nasopharynx.

entities.name: Contaminated Drinking Water
entities.description: Oral ingestion of unchlorinated river, lake, or well water following torrential rainfall.

entities.name: Brown Rat Reservoir
entities.description: Rattus norvegicus as the primary global maintenance host shedding serovar Icterohaemorrhagiae.

entities.name: Black Rat Reservoir
entities.description: Rattus rattus acting as a major domestic and agricultural rodent reservoir host.

entities.name: Domestic Canine Host
entities.description: Domestic dogs shedding Leptospira serovar Canicola into household yards.

entities.name: Domestic Swine Host
entities.description: Swine maintaining chronic asymptomatic renal shedding of serovar Pomona.

entities.name: Dairy Cattle Host
entities.description: Bovine livestock chronically colonized with Leptospira serovar Hardjo.

entities.name: Male Agricultural Laborers
entities.description: Adult males aged 20 to 49 years exhibiting highest occupational morbidity.

entities.name: Elderly Patient Demographics
entities.description: Patients older than 50 years exhibiting highest case fatality and severe disease risk.

entities.name: Typical Incubation Period
entities.description: Standard symptom onset occurring 5 to 14 days following spirochetal inoculation.

entities.name: Extended Incubation Range
entities.description: Complete clinical incubation window ranging from 2 days up to 30 days post-exposure.

entities.name: Post-Monsoon Hurricane Surges
entities.description: Epidemic disease spikes occurring 1 to 3 weeks following severe tropical storms and floods.

entities.name: Purulent Conjunctival Exudate
entities.description: Copious purulent discharge or matting crusts contradicting pure non-purulent suffusion.

entities.name: Transaminases Above 2000 U/L
entities.description: Extreme serum transaminase elevations >2,000 U/L indicating massive hepatocellular necrosis.

entities.name: Transaminases Above 1000 U/L
entities.description: Serum transaminase elevations >1,000 U/L indicating acute viral or toxic hepatitis.

entities.name: Severe Early Leukopenia
entities.description: Total WBC <4,000/µL in acute febrile jaundice contradicting neutrophilic leukocytosis.

entities.name: Profound Neutropenia
entities.description: Absolute neutrophil count <1,000/µL in acute febrile illness arguing against leptospirosis.

entities.name: Biliary Ductal Dilation
entities.description: Ultrasound or CT demonstration of dilated intra- or extrahepatic bile ducts.

entities.name: Intraerythrocytic Malaria Parasites
entities.description: Visualization of Plasmodium trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes on Giemsa blood smear.

entities.name: Pure Unconjugated Hyperbilirubinemia
entities.description: Indirect bilirubin fraction >80% with normal alkaline phosphatase indicating hemolysis.

entities.name: Absence of Water Exposure
entities.description: Zero history of surface water, flood, mud, soil, or rodent exposure within 30 days.

entities.name: Normal Platelet Count
entities.description: Platelet count >150,000/µL in acute severe pulmonary hemorrhage arguing against leptospiral SPHS.

entities.name: Marked Hemoconcentration Without AKI
entities.description: Hematocrit rise >=20% with severe thrombocytopenia in the absence of renal impairment.

entities.name: Normal Serum Creatinine
entities.description: Serum creatinine <1.0 mg/dL in a deeply jaundiced febrile patient with hemorrhage.

entities.name: Severe Cutaneous Eschar
entities.description: Painless black necrotic cigarette-burn eschar with surrounding erythematous halo.

entities.name: Normal C-Reactive Protein
entities.description: Serum CRP <5–10 mg/L in acute severe febrile multi-organ failure.

entities.name: Bacterial Growth in Urine
entities.description: Rapid growth of standard bacterial uropathogens >10^5 CFU/mL on routine 24-hour urine culture.

entities.name: Severe Hyperkalemia in Polyuria
entities.description: Serum potassium >6.0 mEq/L during early polyuric/normouric phase of renal dysfunction.

entities.name: Absence of Muscle Tenderness
entities.description: Zero muscle pain or tenderness with completely normal creatine kinase in early fever.

entities.name: Prominent Splenic Infarctions
entities.description: Wedge-shaped hypodense splenic cortical infarctions on abdominal CT.

entities.name: Bilateral Symmetrical Polyarthritis
entities.description: True inflammatory synovial swelling and joint effusions in small peripheral hand/foot joints.

entities.name: Cold Agglutinin Hemolysis
entities.description: High-titer cold agglutinins and positive direct antiglobulin test.

entities.name: Massive Acute Proteinuria
entities.description: Nephrotic-range proteinuria >3.5 g/24h with severe hypoalbuminemia and hyperlipidemia.

entities.name: Persistent Chronic Fever
entities.description: Unremitting daily fever persisting for >4–6 weeks without acute organ decompensation.

entities.name: Dengue
entities.description: Mosquito-borne arboviral infection causing fever, retro-orbital pain, leukopenia, and plasma leak.

entities.name: Malaria
entities.description: Intraerythrocytic protozoan parasitic infection causing paroxysmal fevers and hemolytic anemia.

entities.name: Scrub Typhus
entities.description: Mite-borne obligate intracellular bacterial infection caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi.

entities.name: Acute Viral Hepatitis
entities.description: Acute viral infection (HAV, HBV, HEV) causing severe hepatocellular necrosis and jaundice.

entities.name: Hantavirus Infection
entities.description: Rodent-borne viral zoonosis causing hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome or pulmonary syndrome.

entities.name: Acute Bacterial Cholangitis
entities.description: Biliary tract bacterial infection presenting with fever, jaundice, and RUQ pain.

entities.name: Yellow Fever
entities.description: Flaviviral hemorrhagic fever presenting with biphasic fever, black vomit, and jaundice.

entities.name: Typhoid Fever
entities.description: Enteric fever caused by Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi presenting with step-ladder fever.

entities.name: Melioidosis
entities.description: Tropical environmental infection caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei forming visceral abscesses.

entities.name: Chikungunya
entities.description: Alphaviral infection presenting with severe incapacitating polyarthralgia and fever.

entities.name: Infective Endocarditis
entities.description: Bacterial endocardial infection presenting with bacteremia, heart murmur, and emboli.

entities.name: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura
entities.description: Microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia and ADAMTS13 deficiency.

entities.name: Acute Meningococcal Sepsis
entities.description: Neisseria meningitidis septicemia causing purpura fulminans, shock, and meningitis.

entities.name: Rickettsial Spotted Fever
entities.description: Tick-borne rickettsial infection causing fever, headache, and centripetal rash.

entities.name: Acute Pyelonephritis
entities.description: Upper urinary tract bacterial infection presenting with flank pain, fever, and pyuria.

entities.name: Legionnaires Disease
entities.description: Severe atypical pneumonia caused by Legionella pneumophila with hyponatremia.

entities.name: Brucellosis
entities.description: Zoonotic bacterial infection causing undulant fever, sweats, and sacroiliitis.

entities.name: Hepatitis E
entities.description: Enterically transmitted acute viral hepatitis presenting with cholestasis and jaundice.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis characteristically exhibits a biphasic clinical course, starting with an acute septicemic bacteremic phase lasting 3 to 7 days, followed by a transient defervescence and a subsequent immune phase marked by circulating antibodies and tissue localization.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Anicteric leptospirosis represents the milder, non-jaundiced presentation accounting for 85% to 90% of symptomatic infections, manifesting as a self-limited acute influenza-like illness with fever, headache, and myalgias that generally resolves within 1 to 2 weeks.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Icteric leptospirosis, or Weil disease, develops in 5% to 15% of infected individuals as a life-threatening illness characterized by intense jaundice, progressive azotemia, hepatic dysfunction, and widespread hemorrhagic manifestations with substantial mortality.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as the severe Weil disease triad comprising rapid conjugated hyperbilirubinemia, acute renal failure, and systemic bleeding diathesis, reflecting profound spirochete-mediated endothelial injury.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe pulmonary hemorrhagic syndrome manifests as catastrophic, rapid-onset intra-alveolar bleeding accompanied by dyspnea, hemoptysis, and hypoxic respiratory failure, frequently developing independently of jaundice with case fatality exceeding 50%.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as acute kidney injury characterized by spirochete-induced tubulointerstitial nephritis and acute tubular necrosis, presenting initially as non-oliguric renal impairment before progressing to oliguria or anuria.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Acute renal dysfunction uniquely manifests in early leptospirosis as non-oliguric or polyuric renal failure due to spirochetal toxin inhibition of the Na+/K+/2Cl- cotransporter in the thick ascending limb of Henle.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] In severe Weil syndrome, renal dysfunction progresses to oliguric or anuric renal failure with profound azotemia, hyperkalemia, and metabolic acidosis requiring urgent hemodialysis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests during the second immune phase as aseptic meningitis in up to 80% of anicteric cases, presenting with severe persistent cephalalgia, nuchal rigidity, and lymphocytic pleocytosis in the cerebrospinal fluid.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as acute myocarditis secondary to direct spirochetal invasion and systemic inflammation, producing conduction disturbances, ventricular hypokinesia, hypotension, and elevated troponin levels.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as acute pancreatitis resulting from microvascular ischemia and toxic acinar injury, presenting with epigastric pain radiating to the back and marked elevations of serum amylase and lipase.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe pulmonary leptospirosis manifests as frank hemoptysis ranging from blood-streaked sputum to massive asphyxiating pulmonary hemorrhage secondary to extensive capillary endothelial disruption.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as acute respiratory distress syndrome with profound hypoxemia, refractory alveolar infiltration, and stiff non-compliant lungs secondary to extensive capillary necrosis and intra-alveolar hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Ocular involvement manifests as marked bilateral subconjunctival hemorrhages and ciliary flush developing against a background of non-purulent suffusion during early bacteremia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests during the post-acute convalescent period as anterior uveitis or iridocyclitis, characterized by photophobia, eye pain, and blurred vision resulting from delayed immune hypersensitivity to persistent spirochetes in the anterior chamber.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Delayed ocular complications manifest as chronic recurrent panuveitis with vitreous opacities and chorioretinitis months after recovery from systemic leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Acute leptospirosis manifests as an abrupt spike of high remittent or continuous fever (39–40°C) occurring within hours of onset, marking rapid bacteremic dissemination.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] The septicemic phase manifests with violent shaking chills and profuse drenching sweats coinciding with peak bacteremic spirochete titers in peripheral blood.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as excruciating, incapacitating frontal and retro-orbital headache accompanied by intense photophobia, reflecting acute intracranial vascular dilation and meningeal irritation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Patients manifest prominent ocular photophobia during both the septicemic phase and subsequent immune aseptic meningitis, exacerbated by ciliary flush.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests as excruciating myalgia localized predominantly to the lumbar paraspinal musculature and calves, frequently immobilizing the patient.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe skeletal muscle involvement manifests as acute rhabdomyolysis with muscle breakdown, marked hyperCKemia, and myoglobinuria that exacerbates acute tubular necrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Cutaneous involvement manifests as a diffuse petechial eruption across the trunk and pretibial regions resulting from immune-mediated capillary vasculitis and marked thrombocytopenia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe Weil disease manifests with broad cutaneous ecchymoses and soft tissue hematomas driven by capillary fragility and consumptive coagulopathy.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Hemorrhagic diathesis frequently manifests as spontaneous epistaxis resulting from mucosal microvascular injury combined with platelet deficiency.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe icteric leptospirosis manifests as gastrointestinal bleeding ranging from coffee-ground emesis to gross melena and hematochezia due to diffuse gastroduodenal mucosal capillary erosions.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Hepatic involvement manifests as acute acalculous cholecystitis with gallbladder wall edema and right upper quadrant pain driven by microvascular ischemia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests with tender hepatomegaly in 25% to 50% of severe icteric cases, associated with canalicular bile stasis and disruption of intercellular junctions.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Systemic spirochetal dissemination manifests as mild-to-moderate splenomegaly in approximately 15% to 25% of patients during the first week of illness.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe leptospirosis manifests as hypotensive shock resulting from systemic capillary endothelial leakage, reduced peripheral vascular resistance, and myocardial depression.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Cardiac involvement manifests as diverse electrocardiographic arrhythmias including sinus tachycardia, atrial fibrillation, and non-specific repolarization changes.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospiral carditis manifests as atrioventricular block ranging from first-degree PR prolongation to high-grade nodal conduction block.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Neuropsychiatric involvement manifests as acute toxic encephalopathy with confusion, fluctuating delirium, and lethargy secondary to severe azotemia, hyperbilirubinemia, and cerebral microvasculitis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Late post-infectious manifestations include peripheral neuropathy, mononeuritis multiplex, and cranial neuropathies (most notably facial palsy) triggered by immune-complex deposition.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Fulminant leptospirosis manifests rarely as bilateral adrenal hemorrhage (Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome), precipitating acute adrenal insufficiency and refractory vascular collapse.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe Weil disease manifests as disseminated intravascular coagulation characterized by profound thrombocytopenia, elevated fibrin degradation products, and microvascular thrombosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Renal parenchyma involvement manifests as gross macroscopic hematuria resulting from acute papillary necrosis and extensive interstitial capillary hemorrhages.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Acute leptospirosis manifests as hypovolemic shock driven by massive polyuric electrolyte wasting, persistent vomiting, severe diaphoresis, and systemic capillary leak.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Gastrointestinal vasculitis manifests rarely as acute mesenteric ischemia and bowel necrosis secondary to spirochetal microthrombosis and intense splanchnic vasoconstriction.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leptospirosis manifests during the late phase as sensorineural hearing loss and tinnitus caused by cranial nerve neuritis or autoimmune inner ear microvascular injury.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Bilateral conjunctival suffusion without inflammatory exudate or pus is present in 60% to 85% of cases on days 3 to 4, representing the cardinal pathognomonic physical hallmark of leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Excruciating tenderness on palpation of the gastrocnemius and soleus calf muscles is a classic pathognomonic physical anchor that strongly differentiates leptospirosis from other tropical fevers.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] The striking orange-bronze tint of scleral icterus and skin, resulting from deep conjugated hyperbilirubinemia superimposed on intense conjunctival suffusion and capillary dilation, is a pathognomonic sign of Weil disease.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Sudden onset of frank hemoptysis in an endemic patient with patchy snowflake alveolar opacities is a pathognomonic herald of lethal severe pulmonary hemorrhagic syndrome.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Inspection of the eyes reveals vivid subconjunctival ecchymoses and flame-shaped hemorrhages against the bright red background of suffused conjunctivae.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Palpation of the back elicits intense lumbar paraspinal muscle tenderness, which together with calf tenderness forms the classic physical triad of leptospiral myositis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Ocular examination demonstrates bilateral circumcorneal ciliary flush without purulent crusting, corneal ulceration, or hypopyon.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical examination during the immune phase demonstrates marked nuchal rigidity with resistance to anterior neck flexion, reflecting aseptic leptospiral meningitis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Bedside neurological testing reveals a positive Kernig sign indicating severe meningeal irritation and spinal root inflammation during immune-phase leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Passive neck flexion elicits involuntary hip and knee flexion (positive Brudzinski sign), confirming acute meningeal inflammation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Abdominal palpation reveals a smoothly enlarged, tender liver edge palpable 2 to 4 cm below the right costal margin in patients with icteric leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Bedside physical exam identifies exquisite tenderness in the right hypochondrium over the liver and gallbladder bed, often mimicking acute surgical abdomen.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Gentle palpation of the left upper quadrant detects a soft, tender palpable splenic tip in approximately one-fifth of patients during acute systemic dissemination.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Dermatological examination reveals non-blanching petechiae and palpable purpuric lesions distributed predominantly over the lower limbs and pressure areas.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Oropharyngeal inspection reveals pinpoint petechial hemorrhages across the soft palate and uvula reflecting generalized microvascular fragility.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Cardiovascular examination reveals warm extremities and bounding peripheral pulses that rapidly deteriorate into cold, clammy distributive shock as vascular resistance collapses.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Vital sign triage may demonstrate relative bradycardia (Faget sign) where pulse rate does not rise proportionally to high spiking core body temperatures.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Cardiac auscultation detects an S3 gallop at the apex, serving as a critical physical warning sign of acute leptospiral myocarditis and ventricular dysfunction.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Auscultation along the left lower sternal border reveals a scratchy superficial pericardial friction rub indicating acute leptospiral serositis and pericarditis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Chest auscultation reveals fine, crepitant bilateral inspiratory crackles over the lung bases reflecting initial alveolar fluid transudation and intra-alveolar hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Progression of alveolar hemorrhage produces harsh tubular bronchial breath sounds and aegophony over expanding areas of pulmonary consolidation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical monitoring demonstrates urine output dropping below 0.5 mL/kg/h, indicating progression from early non-oliguric injury to acute oliguric tubular necrosis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Inspection of the urinary catheter bag reveals frank macroscopic bloody or dark tea-colored urine signaling severe renal tubular hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical examination shows mildly enlarged, tender superficial lymphadenopathy in the anterior cervical and inguinal chains during acute leptospiremia.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Neurological testing reveals widespread cutaneous hyperesthesia and superficial tactile allodynia reflecting acute polyradicular and skeletal muscle irritation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Abdominal examination may demonstrate localized guarding and rebound tenderness mimicking an acute surgical abdomen due to mesenteric microvascular ischemia.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Mental status examination detects acute confusion, delirium, and fluctuating agitation reflecting toxic metabolic encephalopathy and cerebral microvasculitis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Inspection of the lower extremities shows bilateral pitting pedal edema over the dorsum of the feet and ankles, reflecting renal salt retention or capillary leak.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Peripheral blood counts at triage characteristically exhibit marked neutrophilic leukocytosis (WBC 12,000–25,000/µL with >80% neutrophils), strongly distinguishing leptospirosis from viral leukopenia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Complete blood count demonstrates a prominent left shift with immature band forms exceeding 10% to 15% and Dohle bodies, reflecting intense acute bacterial bacteremia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Patients with severe Weil disease or pulmonary hemorrhage may exhibit an extreme leukemoid reaction with peripheral WBC exceeding 30,000/µL in the absence of leukemia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Platelet count drops below 100,000/µL in >50% of severe cases; thrombocytopenia <50,000/µL strongly correlates with pulmonary hemorrhage and acute renal failure.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Routine blood count reveals normocytic normochromic anemia secondary to microvascular mechanical hemolysis, bone marrow suppression, and occult alveolar hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Hepatic panel reveals marked conjugated hyperbilirubinemia with total bilirubin often reaching 10 to 30 mg/dL, reflecting profound canalicular cholestasis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum transaminases (AST and ALT) show only mild to moderate elevation (100–300 U/L, rarely >500 U/L) despite profound jaundice, sharply differentiating leptospirosis from viral hepatocellular necrosis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum alkaline phosphatase is elevated 2 to 5 times the upper limit of normal due to toxic disruption of hepatocanalicular bile export mechanisms.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum amylase and lipase are elevated more than three-fold above normal in up to 25% of cases, reflecting microvascular ischemia to pancreatic acinar tissue.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Renal chemistry demonstrates rapidly rising serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen, reflecting progressive spirochetal tubulointerstitial damage.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum potassium is characteristically low or normal (<3.5 mEq/L) despite acute renal failure in early non-oliguric disease due to loop cotransporter inhibition and renal potassium wasting.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum sodium is characteristically depressed (<130 mEq/L) at triage secondary to impaired tubular sodium reabsorption and inappropriate ADH secretion.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Electrolyte analysis reveals significant hypomagnesemia (<1.5 mg/dL) resulting from spirochetal toxin-mediated tubular dysfunction in the thick ascending limb of Henle.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Total serum creatine kinase is elevated 5 to 20 times the upper limit of normal in over 50% of patients, serving as a powerful diagnostic marker for leptospiral myositis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Inflammatory testing shows extreme elevation of C-reactive protein (>100–250 mg/L), distinguishing leptospirosis from uncomplicated arboviral infections where CRP is typically low.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Erythrocyte sedimentation rate is markedly accelerated (>60–100 mm/h) on admission, reflecting severe systemic microvascular endothelial activation and hyperfibrinogenemia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Urinalysis demonstrates an active sediment with moderate proteinuria (1–2 g/day), microscopic hematuria, pyuria, and granular casts indicative of acute tubular injury.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Urine microscopy reveals sterile pyuria (10–50 WBC/HPF with sterile routine bacterial cultures), confirming abacterial interstitial nephritis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Examination of centrifuged urine sediment reveals muddy brown granular casts diagnostic of acute tubular necrosis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Coagulation profile reveals prolonged prothrombin time and INR >1.5 resulting from impaired hepatic synthesis, severe cholestatic vitamin K deficiency, and consumptive coagulopathy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum D-dimer levels are elevated >5-fold above the normal limit, reflecting microvascular endothelial damage and localized fibrin clot activation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum procalcitonin is markedly elevated (>2 to 10 ng/mL) at triage, corroborating severe bacterial spirochetemia and distinguishing leptospirosis from dengue or malaria.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Lumbar puncture during the immune phase reveals 50 to 500 leukocytes/µL with lymphocytic predominance (>80%), confirming aseptic leptospiral meningitis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Cerebrospinal fluid analysis reveals moderate protein elevation (50–150 mg/dL) with normal CSF-to-serum glucose ratio, typical of immune-phase meningism.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Plain chest radiography reveals bilateral patchy, non-segmental snowflake or snowstorm alveolar infiltrates predominantly involving middle and lower lung zones, indicating pulmonary hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] High-resolution thoracic CT demonstrates extensive bilateral ground-glass opacities and dense consolidation representing intra-alveolar hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Thoracic CT demonstrates a crazy-paving pattern composed of ground-glass opacities with superimposed interlobular septal thickening due to alveolar hemorrhage and interstitial edema.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Chest radiograph demonstrates characteristically dense mid-to-lower zone alveolar infiltrates that spare the extreme apical lung fields and peripheral subpleural margins.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside renal ultrasound shows symmetrically enlarged kidneys (biphasic nephromegaly) with increased cortical echogenicity and prominent medullary pyramids reflecting interstitial edema.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Abdominal ultrasound reveals marked acalculous gallbladder wall edema (>4 mm) with double-rim sign without evidence of intraluminal gallstones or biliary sludge.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside abdominal sonography confirms completely normal, non-dilated intra- and extrahepatic bile ducts (common bile duct <6 mm), ruling out mechanical extrahepatic biliary obstruction.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside lung ultrasound demonstrates diffuse, confluent vertical B-lines across bilateral lung fields indicating acute alveolar-interstitial hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Point-of-care lung ultrasound detects small, irregular subpleural consolidations (<1–2 cm) corresponding to localized subpleural pulmonary hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside transthoracic echocardiogram demonstrates global left ventricular hypokinesia with reduced ejection fraction (<45%) indicating acute myocarditis.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside echocardiogram reveals a small-to-moderate circumferential pericardial effusion without signs of tamponade, confirming acute serositis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] 12-lead electrocardiogram demonstrates first-degree atrioventricular block (PR interval >200 ms) as an early sensitive marker of nodal spirochetal carditis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Electrocardiography shows diffuse ST-segment depression and symmetrical T-wave inversions across precordial leads reflecting subepicardial myocarditis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Blood gas analysis reveals high anion gap metabolic acidosis with low serum bicarbonate (<15 mEq/L) resulting from acute renal failure and lactic acidosis.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Transmission occurs through direct immersion, wading, or swimming in urban floodwaters, canals, or standing rainwater contaminated with urine from chronically infected rodents.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Transmission occurs via direct or indirect contact with wet soil, mud, vegetation, or food items contaminated with urine shed by chronically colonized rodent reservoirs.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Occupational transmission frequently affects rice farmers through prolonged immersion in flooded paddy fields where rodent populations shed spirochetes into warm stagnant water.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Sugarcane field workers experience high transmission risk during manual harvesting due to dense rat populations, wet soil contact, and frequent skin abrasions.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Sewer maintenance personnel face high occupational risk through percutaneous or mucosal contact with raw sewage, effluent, and underground rat nesting environments.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Abattoir workers acquire infection through direct contact of broken skin or conjunctivae with urine, blood, or renal tissues of slaughtered livestock.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Recreational transmission occurs during freshwater sports such as white-water rafting, triathlon swimming, canoeing, and adventure racing in endemic rivers and lakes.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Inhabitants of tropical urban slums face heavy endemic transmission due to open sewers, inadequate sanitation, recurrent seasonal flooding, and dense rat infestations.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Veterinarians and livestock handlers acquire infection via direct contact with placental tissues, aborted fetuses, and infected urine from cattle and swine.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Leptospira spirochetes penetrate the human host predominantly through breached skin, minor abrasions, cuts, or prolonged immersion-macerated epidermis.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Pathogenic spirochetes penetrate intact or irritated mucous membranes of the eyes (conjunctivae), nasopharynx, and oral cavity during accidental water submersion.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Ingestion of unchlorinated drinking water from shallow wells or streams contaminated by storm runoff from animal pastures serves as an occasional route of infection.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] The brown Norway rat (Rattus norvegicus) is the principal global reservoir maintenance host, harboring chronic renal tubular infection and shedding serovar Icterohaemorrhagiae.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] The black roof rat (Rattus rattus) serves as a major domestic and agricultural rodent maintenance host that sheds astronomical counts of viable spirochetes indefinitely.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Domestic dogs represent a key reservoir host, particularly for serovar Canicola, shedding leptospires in urine and exposing pet owners and veterinary personnel.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Domestic pigs act as major reservoir maintenance hosts for Leptospira serovar Pomona, transmitting disease to farm hands and abattoir personnel.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Dairy and beef cattle serve as chronic maintenance hosts for serovar Hardjo, causing occupational exposure among dairy farmers through urine and milk contamination.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Adult males aged 20 to 49 years bear the highest global disease morbidity due to intense occupational engagement in farming, sanitation work, and outdoor labor.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Elderly patients over 50 years of age carry the highest risk of mortality (relative risk >3.7), frequently developing fulminant Weil disease or catastrophic lung hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] The typical incubation period of leptospirosis ranges from 5 to 14 days (median 10 days) between percutaneous inoculation and the abrupt onset of acute fever.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] The outer limits of the leptospirosis incubation period span from 2 to 30 days, reflecting variable inoculum dose and host immune competence.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Dramatic epidemic outbreaks occur 1 to 3 weeks following monsoons, hurricanes, and tropical storms as displaced rodents contaminate widespread standing floodwaters.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] The presence of purulent or mucopurulent conjunctival discharge, crusting, or chemosis effectively rules out the classic non-purulent, non-exudative conjunctival suffusion of leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Serum transaminases (AST or ALT) exceeding 2,000 U/L rule out uncomplicated leptospirosis, in which hepatic involvement produces striking cholestatic jaundice with transaminases typically below 400 U/L.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] AST or ALT elevations above 1,000 U/L strongly indicate acute viral or toxic necrosis rather than leptospirosis, where hepatic architecture is preserved despite deep canalicular jaundice.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Total peripheral white blood cell count <4,000/µL in a patient presenting with acute febrile jaundice and renal failure strongly rules out leptospirosis, which characteristically provokes marked neutrophilic leukocytosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] An absolute neutrophil count <1,000/µL during acute fever rules out bacterial leptospirosis, which consistently triggers brisk granulocytic marrow release and neutrophilia.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Ultrasonographic detection of dilated intrahepatic or extrahepatic biliary ducts or choledocholithiasis rules out leptospirosis in favor of mechanical or ascending bacterial cholangitis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Microscopic visualization of intraerythrocytic Plasmodium species on thin or thick Giemsa blood smears rules in acute malaria as the source of fever, hemolysis, and jaundice.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A bilirubin profile showing predominantly indirect (unconjugated) hyperbilirubinemia (>80% of total) rules out the direct canalicular cholestatic jaundice of leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Complete absence of rainfall, flooding, freshwater immersion, soil contact, animal interaction, or rodent exposure in the preceding 30 days makes leptospirosis extraordinarily improbable.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A normal platelet count (>150,000/µL) in a patient presenting with catastrophic acute alveolar hemorrhage strongly argues against leptospiral severe pulmonary hemorrhagic syndrome.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A rise in hematocrit >=20% paired with thrombocytopenia and low CRP in the absence of acute renal failure rules out leptospirosis in favor of acute Dengue plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Completely normal serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen in a patient presenting with deep bronze jaundice and bleeding diathesis rules out classical Weil disease.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Identification of a pathognomonic necrotic black eschar with an erythematous halo rules out leptospirosis and confirms scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi).

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A normal C-reactive protein level (<5–10 mg/L) during acute severe febrile illness effectively rules out bacterial leptospirosis, which consistently triggers extreme CRP elevations.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Isolation of standard coliform uropathogens (e.g., >10^5 CFU/mL E. coli or Klebsiella) on routine 24-hour urine culture rules in acute bacterial pyelonephritis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Severe hyperkalemia (>6.0 mEq/L) during the early polyuric/normouric phase of renal injury contradicts leptospiral toxin-induced loop potassium wasting, which causes hypokalemia.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Complete absence of calf or lumbar muscle tenderness combined with a normal serum creatine kinase level substantially diminishes the likelihood of early leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Imaging demonstration of large wedge-shaped splenic cortical infarctions rules in infective bacterial endocarditis or embolic septic disease rather than leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] True inflammatory synovial swelling, joint effusion, and morning stiffness in small peripheral joints of the hands and feet rules out leptospirosis in favor of Chikungunya.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Presence of high-titer cold agglutinins and a positive direct Coombs test points to Mycoplasma pneumoniae or Epstein-Barr virus autoimmune hemolysis rather than leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Nephrotic-range proteinuria (>3.5 g/24h) with hypoalbuminemia and hyperlipidemia indicates primary glomerulopathy rather than acute tubulointerstitial leptospirosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Prolonged daily fever lasting >4 to 6 weeks without acute multi-organ decompensation rules out acute biphasic leptospirosis in favor of tuberculosis or visceral leishmaniasis.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Dengue by prominent neutrophilic leukocytosis (WBC >12,000/µL), deep direct hyperbilirubinemia, severe calf tenderness, and high CRP (>100 mg/L), whereas Dengue features leukopenia (WBC <4,000/µL), hemoconcentration, low CRP, and absence of renal failure.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Malaria by conjugated direct hyperbilirubinemia, absence of intraerythrocytic parasites on blood smear, bilateral non-purulent conjunctival suffusion, and early hypokalemic AKI, whereas severe Falciparum Malaria produces unconjugated hemolytic jaundice, elevated LDH, and positive thick blood film.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Scrub Typhus by the absence of an inoculation eschar, absence of generalized maculopapular exanthem, presence of intense conjunctival suffusion, and prominent renal tubular injury with disproportionate hyperbilirubinemia, whereas Scrub Typhus features a pathognomonic black eschar and responds to doxycycline within 24–48 hours.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Acute Viral Hepatitis by transaminases <400–500 U/L, marked leukocytosis with bandemia, acute kidney injury, and elevated creatine kinase, whereas viral hepatitis causes massive hepatocellular transaminitis (AST and ALT >1,000–5,000 U/L) with normal renal function and normal WBC.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Hantavirus infection by direct hyperbilirubinemia, calf tenderness, conjunctival suffusion, and response to penicillin/ceftriaxone, whereas Hantavirus features severe dry retroperitoneal pain, periorbital edema, rapid hemoconcentration, thrombocytopenia without deep jaundice, and zero antibiotic response.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Acute Bacterial Cholangitis by completely normal, non-dilated intra- and extrahepatic bile ducts on abdominal ultrasound, non-purulent conjunctival suffusion, and calf pain, whereas cholangitis exhibits biliary ductal dilation, choledocholithiasis, and bacteremia with enteric coliforms.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Yellow Fever by marked neutrophilic leukocytosis, prominent muscle tenderness, responsiveness to intravenous penicillin, and hypokalemic AKI, whereas Yellow Fever is an arboviral hemorrhagic fever characterized by severe leukopenia, marked AST elevation exceeding ALT, and absence of bacterial antibiotic response.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Typhoid Fever by sudden abrupt onset with rigors, marked leukocytosis, conjunctival suffusion, and acute renal failure, whereas Typhoid Fever features insidious step-ladder fever, relative bradycardia, leukopenia or normal WBC, rose spots, and isolation of Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Melioidosis by prominent conjunctival suffusion, dramatic direct hyperbilirubinemia with mild transaminitis, early hypokalemic AKI, and high sensitivity to penicillin G, whereas Melioidosis features visceral microabscesses (Swiss-cheese spleen/liver), cavitary lung pneumonia, intrinsic penicillin resistance, and culture of Burkholderia pseudomallei.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Chikungunya by acute renal impairment, deep jaundice, pulmonary hemorrhage, and leukocytosis, whereas Chikungunya causes severe crippling polyarthralgia and symmetrical polyarthritis of small peripheral joints without jaundice, renal failure, or prominent leukocytosis.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Leptospirosis is differentiated from Infective Endocarditis by acute biphasic onset linked to floodwater exposure, absence of preexisting valvular vegetations on echocardiogram, and rapid multi-organ failure within days, whereas subacute endocarditis presents with progressive heart murmurs, embolic lesions, and persistent bacteremia.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
