relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Brain metastases: Metastatic lesions typically appear at gray-white junctions with disproportionate extensive surrounding edema, solid nodular enhancement, known primary malignancy, and lack an eccentric scolex dot.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Cerebral toxoplasmosis: Toxoplasmosis predominantly affects advanced HIV/AIDS patients (CD4 <100/uL), presenting as multiple basal ganglia target-enhancing lesions ('eccentric target sign') that respond to pyrimethamine-sulfadiazine, contrasting with immunocompetent NCC epidemiology and EITB seropositivity.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Tuberculous meningitis: TB meningitis presents with thick gelatinous basilar exudate, severe hypoglycorrhachia (CSF glucose <20 mg/dL), elevated adenosine deaminase (ADA), and pulmonary lesions, whereas cysticercotic meningitis has mild/normal glucose, positive LL-GP EITB, and cystic lesions on MRI.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Cryptococcal meningitis: Cryptococcus presents in immunosuppressed patients with positive India ink prep, positive cryptococcal capsular antigen, and gelatinous pseudocysts ('soap bubble' lesions) in basal ganglia, whereas NCC features definitive metacestode scolices and negative fungal markers.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Primary CNS lymphoma: CNS lymphoma presents as dense, homogenous periventricular or subependymal enhancing masses with restricted diffusion in immunocompromised patients, completely lacking the cystic fluid cavity and mural scolex of NCC.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Arachnoid cyst: Congenital arachnoid cysts are extra-axial, perfectly isointense to CSF on all MRI sequences, lack wall enhancement or surrounding edema, have no mural scolex, and remain static in size over years.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Epidermoid cyst: Epidermoid tumors grow along cisterns by creeping into crevices, show marked hyperintensity on DWI with restricted diffusion, and lack inflammatory capsule enhancement or scolex.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Neurovascular stroke: Atherothrombotic stroke presents acutely in older patients with vascular risk factors and territorial vascular wedge distribution, whereas NCC-related stroke occurs in young endemic patients with basilar cisternal cysts causing endarteritis obliterans.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Viral encephalitis: Herpes simplex encephalitis presents with acute fever, confusion, temporal lobe T2/FLAIR hyperintensity with hemorrhagic changes, and positive HSV PCR, unlike afebrile focal seizures caused by discrete NCC parenchymal cysts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Intracranial hydatid cyst: Hydatid disease produces large spherical cysts that can grow up to 10 cm in diameter with calcified pericyst walls, unlike typical parenchymal cysticercosis cysts which measure only 5 to 20 mm.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Bacterial meningitis: Acute bacterial meningitis presents with fulminant fever, septic shock, cloudy CSF with thousands of neutrophils, low glucose, and positive Gram stain/culture, whereas cysticercotic meningitis is chronic, afebrile, and lymphocytic.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Multiple sclerosis: MS produces demyelinating periventricular Dawson fingers, open-ring enhancements, CSF oligoclonal bands, and relapsing-remitting deficits, lacking discrete round cysts with scolices.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Cavernous malformation: Cerebral cavernomas exhibit a characteristic 'popcorn' appearance with a complete hemosiderin hypointense rim on gradient echo/SWI sequences without scolex or true fluid-filled cyst cavity.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, differential diagnosis, pairwise contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Colloid cyst: Third ventricle colloid cysts arise strictly at the foramen of Monro with hyperdense T1-shortening mucinous contents, whereas intraventricular NCC cysts are mobile, located commonly in the fourth ventricle, and contain an invaginated scolex.

entities.name: Paracoccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Chronic granulomatous systemic fungal infection caused by dimorphic fungi of the Paracoccidioides genus (P. brasiliensis complex and P. lutzii), endemic to Latin America, presenting as either an acute juvenile form with reticuloendothelial dissemination or a chronic adult form with moriform stomatitis, pulmonary butterfly-wing infiltrates, and adrenal involvement.

entities.name: Juvenile Disseminated Form
entities.description: Acute or subacute rapidly progressive clinical presentation affecting children, adolescents, and young adults under 30 years of age.

entities.name: Chronic Adult Form
entities.description: Indolent, slowly progressive clinical presentation representing 80% to 90% of paracoccidioidomycosis cases, predominantly in adult males aged 30 to 60 years.

entities.name: Unifocal Pulmonary Disease
entities.description: Localized clinical form of chronic paracoccidioidomycosis restricted exclusively to pulmonary parenchyma without overt extrapulmonary lesions.

entities.name: Multifocal Systemic Disease
entities.description: Widespread chronic presentation involving simultaneous fungal granulomas across multiple organ systems including lungs, mucosa, skin, and adrenals.

entities.name: Reticuloendothelial Dissemination
entities.description: Systemic spread of Paracoccidioides yeasts throughout macrophage-rich organs including lymph nodes, spleen, liver, and bone marrow.

entities.name: Addisonian Crisis
entities.description: Life-threatening acute adrenal crisis precipitated by bilateral granulomatous necrosis of the adrenal glands, causing cardiovascular collapse.

entities.name: Primary Adrenal Insufficiency
entities.description: Endocrine failure resulting from bilateral granulomatous destruction of adrenal cortex by Paracoccidioides, seen in 10% to 15% of chronic cases.

entities.name: Cor Pulmonale
entities.description: Right ventricular enlargement and cardiac failure secondary to precapillary pulmonary hypertension caused by extensive post-infection fibrosis.

entities.name: Pulmonary Fibrosis
entities.description: Permanent architectural scarring and fibrotic distortion of pulmonary parenchyma persisting as a structural sequela after mycological cure.

entities.name: Chronic Productive Cough
entities.description: Persistent daily cough with mucopurulent sputum lasting months to years in adult pulmonary paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Exertional Dyspnea
entities.description: Progressive shortness of breath provoked by physical exertion due to mixed restrictive and obstructive ventilatory impairment.

entities.name: Hemoptysis
entities.description: Expectoration of blood-streaked sputum or overt blood secondary to ulcerative tracheobronchial lesions or cavitary vascular erosion.

entities.name: Severe Odynophagia
entities.description: Intense, debilitating pain on swallowing caused by extensive ulcerative mucosal granulomas of the palate, pharynx, and epiglottis.

entities.name: Dysphonia and Hoarseness
entities.description: Vocal roughness, pitch alteration, and voice loss resulting from granulomatous infiltration and ulceration of the vocal cords.

entities.name: Oral Mulberry Stomatitis
entities.description: Moriform stomatitis of Aguiar-Pupo characterized by granular, erosive oral mucosal ulcers studded with hemorrhagic pinpoint dots.

entities.name: Gingival Infiltration
entities.description: Granulomatous swelling and friability of the gingival margins leading to alveolar bone destruction and dental loosening.

entities.name: Cutaneous Fistulization
entities.description: Spontaneous rupture and chronic sinus tract drainage of caseous purulent material through the skin from infected lymph nodes or bones.

entities.name: Osteolytic Bone Lesions
entities.description: Destructive cortical and medullary osseous lesions with soft tissue cold abscesses, predominantly occurring in the juvenile presentation.

entities.name: Central Nervous Infection
entities.description: Involvement of the central nervous system presenting as brain granulomas (paracoccidioidomas) or chronic basal leptomeningitis.

entities.name: Intracranial Hypertension
entities.description: Elevated intracranial pressure causing severe headaches, projectile vomiting, and papilledema due to space-occupying paracoccidioidomas.

entities.name: Intestinal Dissemination
entities.description: Granulomatous ulceration of the ileocecal region, colon, and appendix resulting in chronic diarrhea, abdominal pain, and malabsorption.

entities.name: Mesenteric Lymphadenomegaly
entities.description: Enlargement and matted conglomeration of intra-abdominal and retroperitoneal lymph node chains, sometimes causing extrinsic biliary compression.

entities.name: Protein-Losing Enteropathy
entities.description: Severe loss of serum proteins into the gastrointestinal lumen caused by fungal lymphatic obstruction in juvenile paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Severe Weight Loss
entities.description: Profound progressive involuntary loss of body weight and adipose tissue driven by chronic cytokine elevation and swallowing impairment.

entities.name: Marked Asthenia
entities.description: Generalized muscle weakness, chronic fatigue, and prostration exacerbated by subclinical adrenal insufficiency and chronic inflammation.

entities.name: High Spiking Fever
entities.description: Daily elevated temperature spikes exceeding 38.5-39°C with night sweats and rigors, typical of acute reticuloendothelial dissemination.

entities.name: Chylous Ascites
entities.description: Peritoneal accumulation of milky lymphatic fluid caused by fungal blockage or rupture of retroperitoneal lymph vessels.

entities.name: Genitourinary Involvement
entities.description: Granulomatous dissemination to epididymides, testes, or prostate causing nodular swelling, pelvic discomfort, and dysuria.

entities.name: Thyroid Granulomas
entities.description: Infiltration of the thyroid gland by fungal granulomas presenting as painless or tender goiter-like enlargement.

entities.name: Splenomegaly
entities.description: Enlargement of the spleen secondary to dense granulomatous yeast colonization throughout the red and white pulp.

entities.name: Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Diffuse liver enlargement caused by granulomatous inflammation of hepatic parenchyma and portal triads.

entities.name: Laryngeal Obstruction
entities.description: Critical narrowing of the upper airway lumen by extensive vegetative granulomatous tissue across the glottis and epiglottis.

entities.name: Tracheal Ulceration
entities.description: Mucosal erosions and vegetative plaques lining the trachea and mainstem bronchi predisposing to airway stenosis.

entities.name: Cutaneous Papulopustules
entities.description: Erythematous papules, pustules, and small ulcerated cutaneous nodules arising from hematogenous dissemination of Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Vegetative Skin Plaques
entities.description: Elevated, verrucous, crusting cutaneous plaques with hyperkeratotic borders resulting from direct fungal proliferation in the dermis.

entities.name: Secondary Bacterial Superinfection
entities.description: Superimposed bacterial cellulitis and tissue necrosis complicating open mucosal or cutaneous paracoccidioidal ulcers.

entities.name: Endocrine Hypoadrenalism
entities.description: Impaired corticosteroid synthesis and deficient mineralocorticoid production secondary to bilateral adrenal gland destruction.

entities.name: Post-Infectious Microstomia
entities.description: Severe cicatricial stenosis of the oral opening resulting from fibrotic contracture following healed perioral moriform ulcers.

entities.name: Mulberry Stomatitis
entities.description: Classic moriform ulcerative stomatitis studded with pinpoint red petechial dots on an infiltrative base.

entities.name: Tapir Mouth Deformity
entities.description: Pronounced thickening, wooden induration, and anterior protrusion of the lips resulting from extensive mucosal granulomas.

entities.name: Pilot's Wheel Yeasts
entities.description: Large spherical central mother yeast cell ringed by multiple circumferential narrow-necked daughter buds on microscopy.

entities.name: Loose Painful Dentition
entities.description: Hypermobility and spontaneous shedding of teeth caused by deep periodontal granulomatous infiltration and alveolar bone lysis.

entities.name: Fine Hemorrhagic Stippling
entities.description: Tiny pinpoint vascular dots scattered across the granular floor of mucosal ulcers on oral physical examination.

entities.name: Matted Cervical Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Firm or hard coalescent conglomerations of cervical and submandibular lymph nodes adherent to surrounding subcutaneous structures.

entities.name: Suppurative Nodal Fistulae
entities.description: Draining cutaneous sinus tracts discharging yellowish purulent material from softened, necrotic lymph node packages.

entities.name: Labial Ulcerative Infiltration
entities.description: Indurated, hypertrophic swelling and painful granular ulceration involving the mucosal and cutaneous borders of the lips.

entities.name: Palatal Mucosal Ulceration
entities.description: Granular moriform ulcerations spreading across the hard and soft palate, often involving the uvula and palatopharyngeal arches.

entities.name: Profuse Sialorrhea
entities.description: Continuous involuntary drooling of saliva provoked by severe swallowing pain and excessive salivary reflex stimulation.

entities.name: Vocal Cord Granulomas
entities.description: Direct visualization of granular, hyperemic vegetative plaques along the true vocal folds on indirect or flexible laryngoscopy.

entities.name: Inspiratory Stridor
entities.description: High-pitched musical sound heard during inspiration indicating critical mechanical narrowing of the larynx by vegetative lesions.

entities.name: Cutaneous Melanoderma
entities.description: Hyperpigmentation of cutaneous folds, palmar creases, and mucous membranes driven by elevated ACTH in primary adrenal failure.

entities.name: Orthostatic Hypotension
entities.description: Marked reduction in arterial blood pressure upon standing indicative of mineralocorticoid deficiency and hypovolemia.

entities.name: Bilateral Pulmonary Crackles
entities.description: Auscultatory crackling sounds heard over mid-thoracic lung fields during inspiration reflecting alveolar and interstitial infiltration.

entities.name: Generalized Peripheral Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Widespread palpation of enlarged, rubbery lymph nodes across multiple nodal stations including cervical, axillary, and inguinal regions.

entities.name: Supraclavicular Node Enlargement
entities.description: Palpable unilateral or bilateral supraclavicular lymph node swelling indicative of systemic lymphatic dissemination.

entities.name: Firm Splenomegaly
entities.description: Palpation of a firm, enlarged spleen extending below the left costal margin on abdominal examination.

entities.name: Nodular Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Palpation of an enlarged liver with a tender, blunt edge and irregular surface texture on physical examination.

entities.name: Perioral Verrucous Plaques
entities.description: Vegetative, crusted, wart-like cutaneous plaques distributed around the mouth, chin, and nasolabial folds.

entities.name: Cutaneous Papulonecrotic Lesions
entities.description: Discrete erythematous papules showing central necrosis and crusting distributed over the face and extremities.

entities.name: Subcutaneous Cold Abscesses
entities.description: Fluctuant, non-warm, indolent subcutaneous fluid collections arising from adjacent osteolytic or lymphatic fungal lesions.

entities.name: Temporal Muscle Wasting
entities.description: Marked depression of the bitemporal fossae reflecting advanced skeletal muscle wasting and systemic malnutrition.

entities.name: Alveolar Ridge Granuloma
entities.description: Tumor-like exophytic granular tissue developing along maxillary or mandibular dental ridges in chronic disease.

entities.name: Gingival Bleeding
entities.description: Easy provocability of capillary bleeding from hyperemic, spongy gingival tissue upon gentle dental touch.

entities.name: Uvular Granulomatous Destruction
entities.description: Extensive erosive mutilation or complete anatomical loss of the uvula caused by chronic necrotizing granulomas.

entities.name: Tongue Dorsum Ulceration
entities.description: Deep fissures and granular moriform ulcerative plaques involving the dorsal or lateral surfaces of the tongue.

entities.name: Mickey Mouse Yeasts
entities.description: Characteristic yeast morphology featuring two prominent symmetrical daughter buds resembling Mickey Mouse head on wet mount.

entities.name: Mariner's Wheel Morphology
entities.description: Classic pathognomonic pilot's wheel microscopic structure composed of a large central yeast surrounded by multiple daughter buds.

entities.name: KOH Direct Mount
entities.description: Rapid bedside direct examination of scrapings with 10-20% potassium hydroxide clearing host cells to expose double-contoured yeasts.

entities.name: Calcofluor White Staining
entities.description: Fluorescent optical brightener binding to chitin in fungal cell walls revealing bright fluorochrome emission under ultraviolet light.

entities.name: Grocott Silver Stain
entities.description: Methenamine silver histochemical staining yielding black-staining fungal walls against light green background on tissue biopsy.

entities.name: Periodic Acid-Schiff Stain
entities.description: Histochemical stain producing intense magenta staining of fungal cell wall carbohydrates and polysaccharides in tissue sections.

entities.name: Double Immunodiffusion Positivity
entities.description: Serological precipitin band formation against Paracoccidioides gp43 antigen on agar gel immunodiffusion, offering high specificity.

entities.name: High Gp43 Antibody
entities.description: Elevated circulating precipitin antibody titers against the immunodominant 43 kDa glycoprotein of Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Peripheral Blood Eosinophilia
entities.description: Marked elevation of circulating eosinophil counts (>10% to 30% of differential) characteristic of acute juvenile disease.

entities.name: Normocytic Normochromic Anemia
entities.description: Depression of hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal mean corpuscular volume characteristic of chronic inflammation.

entities.name: Elevated Erythrocyte Sedimentation
entities.description: Marked acceleration of Westergren ESR exceeding 60 to 100 mm/hr indicating active chronic granulomatous inflammation.

entities.name: Elevated C-Reactive Protein
entities.description: Serum acute-phase reactant elevation exceeding 50 to 100 mg/L reflecting ongoing inflammatory tissue injury.

entities.name: Serum Hyponatremia
entities.description: Reduced serum sodium level (<135 mEq/L) resulting from mineralocorticoid insufficiency in bilateral adrenal involvement.

entities.name: Serum Hyperkalemia
entities.description: Elevated serum potassium concentration (>5.0 mEq/L) caused by impaired distal renal tubule excretion in Addisonian failure.

entities.name: Low Morning Cortisol
entities.description: Depressed 8 AM baseline plasma cortisol concentration (<5 µg/dL) reflecting primary adrenal gland destruction.

entities.name: Blunted ACTH Stimulation
entities.description: Inability of adrenal cortex to elevate serum cortisol above 18 µg/dL following administration of synthetic cosyntropin.

entities.name: Hypergammaglobulinemia
entities.description: Polyclonal elevation of serum gamma globulins, IgG, and IgE reflecting intense non-protective humoral immune activation.

entities.name: Hypoalbuminemia
entities.description: Depressed serum albumin concentration (<3.0 g/dL) resulting from negative hepatic acute-phase response and malabsorption.

entities.name: Thrombocytosis
entities.description: Reactive elevation of circulating platelet count (>450,000/µL) driven by systemic thrombopoietin and inflammatory cytokines.

entities.name: Mild Leukocytosis
entities.description: Elevation of total white blood cell count (10,000 to 16,000/µL) with neutrophilia and toxic granulations.

entities.name: Elevated Alkaline Phosphatase
entities.description: Elevation of hepatic alkaline phosphatase enzyme levels reflecting granulomatous space-occupying lesions in liver tissue.

entities.name: Positive Paracoccidioidin Reaction
entities.description: Delayed-type cutaneous hypersensitivity induration (>5 mm at 48 hours) confirming specific cellular immune recognition.

entities.name: Butterfly Wing Infiltrates
entities.description: Classic bilateral symmetrical perihilar opacities radiating outwards across middle lung zones on chest radiograph.

entities.name: Bat-Wing Opacities
entities.description: Perihilar consolidation pattern with bilateral mid-lung distribution sparing apical and basilar zones on thoracic imaging.

entities.name: Reversed Halo Sign
entities.description: Focal ground-glass opacity completely or partially encircled by a dense ring of consolidation on high-resolution thoracic CT.

entities.name: Interlobular Septal Thickening
entities.description: Prominent linear opacities outlining pulmonary secondary lobules on high-resolution chest CT reflecting interstitial infiltration.

entities.name: Centrilobular Nodules
entities.description: Multiple small soft-tissue nodules clustered around terminal bronchioles on thoracic computed tomography.

entities.name: Ground-Glass Opacities
entities.description: Hazy increased pulmonary attenuation without obscuration of underlying bronchial or vascular structures on chest CT.

entities.name: Parenchymal Bands
entities.description: Thick linear fibrotic scars traversing the lung parenchyma and contacting the pleural surface on high-resolution CT.

entities.name: Traction Bronchiectasis
entities.description: Irregular, non-uniform dilatation of bronchi resulting from surrounding retractile parenchymal fibrosis on CT imaging.

entities.name: Apical Lung Sparing
entities.description: Characteristic radiological preservation of extreme apical lung zones, contrasting with upper lobe predilection of tuberculosis.

entities.name: Basilar Lung Sparing
entities.description: Relative preservation of the inferior costophrenic angles and extreme pulmonary bases on plain chest radiograph.

entities.name: Bilateral Adrenal Enlargement
entities.description: Prominent symmetric or asymmetric enlargement of both adrenal gland limbs on cross-sectional abdominal CT.

entities.name: Adrenal Peripheral Calcification
entities.description: High-density rim-like or punctate calcifications along the periphery of chronically infected adrenal glands on CT.

entities.name: Adrenal Central Hypoattenuation
entities.description: Low-attenuation central areas within enlarged adrenal glands representing caseous or suppurative necrosis on contrast CT.

entities.name: Mesenteric Lymph Node Masses
entities.description: Multiple enlarged, coalescent intra-abdominal lymph nodes with central hypoattenuation seen on contrast abdominal CT.

entities.name: Osteolytic Skeletal Lesions
entities.description: Punched-out cortical bone defects with minimal sclerotic reaction on skeletal plain films or CT scans.

entities.name: Intracranial Ring Enhancement
entities.description: Focal nodular brain lesions with surrounding ring of contrast enhancement and extensive vasogenic edema on neuroimaging.

entities.name: Soil Microconidia Inhalation
entities.description: Inhalation of aerosolized infectious fungal microconidia liberated from disturbed topsoil during outdoor agricultural activities.

entities.name: Coffee Plantation Work
entities.description: Occupational manual handling of soil and foliage during coffee harvesting and drying in endemic agricultural regions.

entities.name: Tobacco Cultivation Labor
entities.description: Agricultural activities related to tobacco planting, manual tilling, and harvest associated with increased fungal infection risk.

entities.name: Disturbed Acidic Soils
entities.description: Contact with humid, acidic, sandy soils near river basins providing the ecological microniche for Paracoccidioides mycelial growth.

entities.name: Nine-Banded Armadillo Burrows
entities.description: Proximity to burrows of Dasypus novemcinctus, the major natural sylvatic mammalian host harboring Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Rural Canine Reservoirs
entities.description: Cohabitation with rural domestic dogs that frequently acquire subclinical and clinical Paracoccidioides infections in endemic areas.

entities.name: Deforestation Soil Disturbance
entities.description: Heavy mechanical forest clearance and agricultural frontier expansion that mobilizes vast soil dust clouds into the atmosphere.

entities.name: Hydroelectric Dam Construction
entities.description: Large civil engineering projects involving deep excavation and river alteration linked to regional surges in fungal infection.

entities.name: Continental Latin America
entities.description: Strict geographic confinement of native Paracoccidioides transmission between southern Mexico and northern Argentina.

entities.name: Brazilian Endemic Territories
entities.description: Geographic residence in Brazil, which accounts for greater than 80% of all diagnosed paracoccidioidomycosis cases worldwide.

entities.name: Amazon Basin Expansion
entities.description: Expanding hyperendemic agricultural frontier zone across the western Brazilian Amazon states including Rondonia and Acre.

entities.name: Colombian Andean Focus
entities.description: Endemic coffee-producing mountainous departments of Colombia representing a major secondary South American endemic focus.

entities.name: Venezuelan Northern Region
entities.description: Endemic agricultural zones located in Bolivar state and northern mountainous farming regions of Venezuela.

entities.name: Adult Male Predilection
entities.description: Striking epidemiological male predominance with a 10:1 to 15:1 male-to-female ratio in chronic adult disease.

entities.name: Estrogen Transformation Block
entities.description: Hormonal protection in premenopausal females mediated by 17-beta-estradiol blocking conidia-to-yeast dimorphic transformation.

entities.name: Heavy Tobacco Smokers
entities.description: Over 14-fold increased clinical risk of chronic pulmonary paracoccidioidomycosis in individuals with heavy cigarette smoking history.

entities.name: Heavy Alcohol Consumers
entities.description: Elevated susceptibility to progressive fungal disease in individuals regularly consuming distilled alcohol exceeding 50 g daily.

entities.name: Rural Agricultural Laborers
entities.description: Field workers, coffee pickers, and earth movers with frequent direct exposure to aerosolized agricultural soil particles.

entities.name: Cellular Immunosuppression Hosts
entities.description: Patients with defective cell-mediated immunity such as HIV coinfection or organ transplantation who develop severe dissemination.

entities.name: HLA-A9 Genetic Allele
entities.description: Immunogenetic susceptibility linked to higher frequencies of HLA-A9, HLA-B13, and specific cytokine receptor polymorphisms.

entities.name: Decade-Scale Clinical Latency
entities.description: Prolonged clinical incubation period spanning 10 to 30 or more years between primary infection and adult symptomatic reactivation.

entities.name: Juvenile Incubation Period
entities.description: Rapid clinical incubation period lasting several weeks to months between spore inhalation and acute reticuloendothelial disease.

entities.name: Remote Travel Latency
entities.description: Appearance of active disease in non-endemic regions decades after an individual emigrated from an endemic Latin American zone.

entities.name: Hyperacute 48-Hour Onset
entities.description: Symptom emergence within 48 to 72 hours, which is incompatible with the indolent subacute or chronic course of paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Premenopausal Female Presentation
entities.description: Development of chronic multifocal disease in healthy premenopausal females, an exceptionally rare event due to estrogen inhibition.

entities.name: Zero Latin America Travel
entities.description: Complete lack of lifetime residence in or travel to continental Latin America, conclusively excluding native infection.

entities.name: Interhuman Spontaneous Transmission
entities.description: Direct contagion between infected persons, which never occurs in paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Response to Antibacterial Drugs
entities.description: Rapid complete clinical resolution of pulmonary or mucosal lesions following standard antibacterial therapy.

entities.name: Purely Epidermal Desquamation
entities.description: Cutaneous signs restricted solely to superficial non-ulcerative scaling without granular or ulcerative dermal and mucosal involvement.

entities.name: Absence of Yeasts
entities.description: Repeated negative microscopy and fungal cultures of adequate biopsies and scraping specimens from active lesions.

entities.name: Negative Gp43 Serology
entities.description: Complete absence of serum precipitin antibodies against gp43 antigen on double immunodiffusion in an immunocompetent patient.

entities.name: Isolated Apical Cavitation
entities.description: Strictly isolated unilateral upper lobe cavity without perihilar or mid-zone reticulonodular infiltrates.

entities.name: Lack of Soil Exposure
entities.description: Strict urban life with no history of rural habitation, agricultural employment, or soil-disturbing hobbies.

entities.name: Rapid Spontaneous Remission
entities.description: Spontaneous involution of extensive ulcerative mucosal or cutaneous lesions without antifungal treatment.

entities.name: True Animal-to-Human Contagion
entities.description: Alleged transmission directly from living animals to humans, which does not occur as both are accidental dead-end hosts.

entities.name: Negative Biopsy Histology
entities.description: Adequate deep tissue biopsy demonstrating non-granulomatous histology devoid of fungal yeasts on fungal stains.

entities.name: Exclusive Waterborne Outbreak
entities.description: Acute diarrheal or systemic epidemic linked directly to contaminated municipal drinking water.

entities.name: Absence of Mucocutaneous Ulcers
entities.description: Presentation of long-standing pulmonary symptoms in older men without any upper aerodigestive tract or cutaneous lesions.

entities.name: Refractoriness to Azoles
entities.description: Complete clinical and mycological failure under compliant, confirmed therapeutic dosing of oral itraconazole.

entities.name: Normal Cortisol in Shock
entities.description: Demonstration of robustly elevated serum cortisol (>25 µg/dL) during acute hypotensive collapse, ruling out Addisonian crisis.

entities.name: Lack of Pulmonary Granulomas
entities.description: Completely normal high-resolution chest CT in a patient suspected of having disseminated chronic multifocal disease.

entities.name: Solely Intraerythrocytic Parasites
entities.description: Microscopic demonstration of intracellular parasites inside erythrocytes, indicative of malaria or babesiosis.

entities.name: Acid-Fast Positive Smear
entities.description: Identification of red-staining acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain of sputum confirming mycobacterial infection.

entities.name: Purely Intracellular Yeast
entities.description: Presence of exclusively tiny (2-4 µm) yeasts inside macrophages replicating by single budding, diagnostic of histoplasmosis.

entities.name: Malignant Epithelial Atypia
entities.description: Histopathological demonstration of dysplastic, keratinizing malignant squamous cells on punch biopsy of an oral ulcer.

entities.name: Pulmonary Tuberculosis
entities.description: Major bacterial mimic caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, presenting with apical cavitary pulmonary lesions and systemic wasting.

entities.name: Mucocutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Protozoan parasitic infection caused by Leishmania braziliensis producing mutilating destructive ulcerations of the nasal septum and palate.

entities.name: Histoplasmosis
entities.description: Endemic dimorphic fungal infection caused by Histoplasma capsulatum presenting with hepatosplenomegaly, pulmonary lesions, and mucosal ulcers.

entities.name: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
entities.description: Malignant epithelial neoplasm of the oral cavity and larynx presenting with indurated, destructive ulcers in older male smokers.

entities.name: Blastomycosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection caused by Blastomyces dermatitidis endemic to North America, producing pyogranulomatous lung and skin lesions.

entities.name: Coccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection caused by Coccidioides immitis or posadasii endemic to arid regions of the southwestern US and northern Mexico.

entities.name: Cryptococcosis
entities.description: Encapsulated opportunistic fungal infection caused by Cryptococcus neoformans presenting with subacute meningoencephalitis and pulmonary nodules.

entities.name: Sporotrichosis
entities.description: Subacute or chronic fungal infection caused by Sporothrix schenckii complex presenting with nodular lymphocutaneous lesions along lymphatic drainage.

entities.name: Hodgkin Lymphoma
entities.description: Malignant lymphoma characterized by neoplastic Reed-Sternberg cells presenting with painless lymphadenopathy and systemic B symptoms.

entities.name: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
entities.description: Heterogeneous group of lymphoid neoplasms presenting with painless generalized nodal masses, hepatosplenomegaly, and cytopenias.

entities.name: Pulmonary Sarcoidosis
entities.description: Systemic non-caseating granulomatous disease primarily affecting thoracic lymph nodes and lung parenchyma with elevated ACE levels.

entities.name: Wegener Granulomatosis
entities.description: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis, an ANCA-associated necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis involving upper and lower respiratory tracts.

entities.name: Crohn's Disease
entities.description: Chronic idiopathic inflammatory bowel disease with transmural non-caseating granulomatous inflammation throughout the gastrointestinal tract.

entities.name: Syphilitic Gumma
entities.description: Destructive granulomatous tertiary syphilis lesion affecting mucosal surfaces, bone, and skin with obliterative endarteritis.

entities.name: Actinomycosis
entities.description: Chronic granulomatous infection caused by Actinomyces israelii producing woody facial induration and sinus tracts discharging sulfur granules.

entities.name: Bacterial Cervical Adenitis
entities.description: Acute pyogenic infection of cervical lymph nodes caused by Staphylococcus aureus or Streptococcus pyogenes responding to antibiotics.

entities.name: Talaromycosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection caused by Talaromyces marneffei endemic to Southeast Asia, characterized by skin papules with central umbilication.

entities.name: Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia
entities.description: Opportunistic fungal pulmonary infection caused by Pneumocystis jirovecii causing severe hypoxemic pneumonia in immunocompromised hosts.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Presents in children and young adults under 30 years as an acute or subacute, rapidly progressive reticuloendothelial syndrome with severe lymphadenopathy and hepatosplenomegaly.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Represents 80% to 90% of cases, manifesting insidiously in mature adults with indolent progression of respiratory and mucocutaneous pathology.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as chronic localized parenchymal lung involvement without clinically overt extrapulmonary dissemination in approximately 25% of chronic adult presentations.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as widespread hematogenous and lymphatic dissemination affecting simultaneously the lungs, upper aerodigestive mucosa, skin, adrenal glands, and lymph nodes.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with massive diffuse fungal proliferation throughout the monocyte-macrophage system, including liver, spleen, bone marrow, and lymph node chains.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as life-threatening acute adrenal insufficiency characterized by profound shock, vascular collapse, extreme asthenia, and severe electrolyte derangement following bilateral adrenal necrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests in 10% to 15% of chronic adult cases due to bilateral granulomatous destruction of adrenal cortical tissue with subclinical reserve loss in up to 50%.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as right ventricular hypertrophy and cardiac failure secondary to severe precapillary pulmonary hypertension caused by extensive post-infection pulmonary interstitial fibrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as progressive, irreversible architectural distortion and dense fibrotic scarring of lung parenchyma persisting even after microbiological cure with antifungal therapy.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as protracted daily cough with copious mucopurulent or purulent sputum production enduring over months to years in adult chronic disease.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as progressively worsening breathlessness on physical effort resulting from restrictive and obstructive ventilation impairment.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as recurrent blood-tinged sputum or frank pulmonary hemorrhage secondary to ulcerating bronchial lesions and vascular erosion in fibrocavitary disease.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as excruciating mucosal pain upon swallowing solid and liquid foods, severely impairing nutrition and resulting in progressive cachexia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as persistent vocal roughness and voice loss due to direct granulomatous ulceration and infiltration of the true and false vocal cords.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as ulcerative mucosal inflammation of the oral cavity characterized by granular moriform bases with pinpoint red vascular dots.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as painful, friable granulomatous thickening of the gums with alveolar bone resorption and progressive loosening of teeth.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as spontaneous rupture and sinus tract formation discharging purulent material from suppurating subcutaneous lymph nodes or osteolytic bone foci.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests predominantly in juvenile disease as destructive lytic lesions affecting clavicles, ribs, skull, and long bones with overlying soft tissue abscesses.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests in 10% to 12% of disseminated cases as pseudotumoral neuroparacoccidioidomycosis or chronic basilar granulomatous meningitis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with progressive headache, vomiting, papilledema, and focal neurological deficits caused by space-occupying cerebral or cerebellar paracoccidioidomas.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with ulcerations of the ileocecal region and colon causing chronic diarrhea, abdominal cramping, malabsorption, and intestinal subocclusion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as conglomerate intra-abdominal nodal masses compressing the mesenteric vessels and biliary tract, potentially producing obstructive jaundice.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests in severe juvenile cases as profound hypoalbuminemia and anasarca resulting from lymphatic obstruction and chylous exudation into the bowel lumen.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as involuntary, dramatic loss of body mass (wasting) due to elevated systemic inflammatory cytokines combined with mechanical odynophagia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as profound physical exhaustion, muscular weakness, and lethargy exacerbated by adrenal hypofunction and chronic systemic inflammation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests typically in the acute juvenile form as daily septic fever peaks exceeding 39°C accompanied by drenching chills and diaphoresis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as accumulation of milky, triglyceride-rich peritoneal fluid secondary to fungal obstruction or rupture of the retroperitoneal lymphatic duct network.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as granulomatous prostatitis, epididymitis, or testicular enlargement causing pelvic pain, dysuria, and secondary infertility.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as painless or tender goiter-like enlargement with replacement of parenchymal tissue by Paracoccidioides granulomas, occasionally producing hypothyroidism.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as massive, tender or firm enlargement of the spleen resulting from extensive granulomatous infiltration in acute reticuloendothelial disease.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as palpable, tender enlargement of the liver with smooth or nodular surfaces due to diffuse intralobular and portal granuloma formation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as acute or subacute upper airway compromise and inspiratory stridor from bulky vegetative lesions obstructing the laryngeal vestibule.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as erosive and vegetative lesions of the tracheobronchial mucosa predisposing to bronchial stenosis and secondary atelectasis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as disseminated crusted papules, pustules, and ulcerated nodules across facial, truncal, and extremity skin via hematogenous dissemination.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as elevated, verrucous or papillomatous cutaneous lesions with hyperkeratotic borders and central exudation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests with foul-smelling purulence, worsening tissue destruction, and localized cellulitis complicating open moriform oral or skin ulcers.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as subclinical or overt hypocortisolemia accompanied by blunted adrenocorticotropic hormone stimulation responses.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Manifests as severe scarring contracture of the oral aperture following extensive cicatrization of perioral and labial ulcers.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Features Aguiar-Pupo's moriform ulcerative lesions studded with pinpoint red petechial dots on an infiltrative granular mucosal base.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Features marked thickening, induration, and forward protrusion of the lips (boca de anta) resulting from destructive granulomatous infiltration.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Features the pathognomonic microscopic appearance of a large central mother yeast cell ringed by multiple circumferential narrow-necked daughter buds.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals progressive periodontal destruction, gingival retraction, and mobile teeth caused by alveolar granulomatous invasion.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals minute red vascular micro-punctuations scattered across the ulcerated oropharyngeal and gingival mucosa on direct inspection.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals large, coalescent, rubbery or hard chains of cervical and submandibular lymph nodes forming adherent multinodular masses.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals spontaneous cutaneous rupture of fluctuating lymph nodes discharging thick purulent material rich in viable yeast cells.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals swollen, cracked, and deeply eroded mucosal surfaces of upper and lower lips with everted margins.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals granular, shallow or deep ulcerations spanning the hard and soft palate, often extending to the uvula and tonsillar pillars.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals excessive, involuntary drooling of saliva resulting from painful swallowing reflexes and hypersecretion from irritated oral mucosa.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals mucosal hyperemia, nodular thickening, and ulcerations along the vocal folds on indirect or fiberoptic laryngoscopy.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals a harsh, high-pitched monophonic sound heard on lung auscultation caused by critical laryngeal or subglottic stenosis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals diffuse bronzing and hyperpigmentation of palmar creases, buccal mucosa, and pressure points driven by elevated ACTH in primary adrenal failure.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals a substantial postural drop in systolic and diastolic arterial pressure due to mineralocorticoid deficiency in Addisonian involvement.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals fine to coarse end-inspiratory crepitations auscultated symmetrically over the mid-thoracic lung fields.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals widespread enlargement of cervical, axillary, epitrochlear, and inguinal nodal stations in the juvenile presentation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals firm or fluctuant enlargement of the left or right supraclavicular lymph node chains indicative of lymphatic dissemination.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals a palpable splenic edge extending centimeters below the left costal margin with marked dullness to percussion.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals a blunt, tender liver edge palpable below the right costal margin with surface nodularity from granuloma formation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals crusting, hypertrophic, warty skin lesions distributed across the chin, nasolabial folds, and perioral dermis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals discrete erythematous papules with central necrosis and ulceration distributed over the face and trunk.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals indolent, non-erythematous, fluctuant soft-tissue collections tracking from underlying infected bone or lymph nodes.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals bitemporal hollowing and visible bony prominence reflecting severe chronic protein-calorie malnutrition and cachexia.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals exophytic, bleeding, granular tumor-like tissue along the maxillary or mandibular dental arches.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals spontaneous or easily provoked capillary hemorrhage from friable, hyperemic gingival tissues upon minimal palpation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals partial or complete erosion and mutilation of the uvula and adjacent soft palate margins.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Reveals deep, painful fissures and granular vegetative ulcers involving the lateral borders and dorsal surface of the tongue.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits distinctive bi-budding yeast morphology resembling Mickey Mouse ears on direct microscopic mount.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits pathognomonic spherical mother cells (15-30 µm) encircled by numerous narrow-based daughter buds (2-6 µm) on direct KOH or calcofluor mount.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits highly refractile, thick, double-contoured cell walls and multi-budding yeasts within minutes of adding 10% to 20% potassium hydroxide to clinical scrapings.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits brilliant apple-green or blue-white fluorescence of chitinous fungal cell walls under ultraviolet fluorescence microscopy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits sharply demarcated brownish-black multi-budding yeast cells against a pale green counterstain on tissue histological sections.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits deep magenta or red staining of complex carbohydrate-rich fungal cell wall polysaccharides in biopsy specimens.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits specific precipitin bands against Paracoccidioides brasiliensis gp43 exoantigen with >90% sensitivity and >95% diagnostic specificity.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits elevated serum precipitin titers reflecting active clinical disease, which progressively decline towards negative with successful therapy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits marked absolute eosinophil elevation (>10% to 30% of differential white count) predominantly in the acute juvenile form.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits reduced hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal red cell indices characteristic of long-standing systemic inflammatory disease.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits marked acceleration of Westergren ESR, frequently exceeding 60 to 100 mm in the first hour.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits markedly elevated serum CRP concentrations (>50 to 100 mg/L) indicating ongoing systemic granulomatous inflammation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits reduced serum sodium concentrations (<135 mEq/L) stemming from mineralocorticoid deficit in bilateral adrenal cortex destruction.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits elevated serum potassium levels (>5.0 mEq/L) caused by impaired distal renal tubular potassium excretion in primary Addisonian failure.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits baseline 8 AM serum cortisol levels below 5 µg/dL, confirming primary adrenal cortical destruction.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits complete failure of serum cortisol to rise above 18 µg/dL after administration of synthetic cosyntropin.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits polyclonal elevation of serum gamma globulin fractions and elevated total IgG and IgE levels on serum protein electrophoresis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits depressed serum albumin levels (<3.0 g/dL) secondary to negative acute-phase hepatic reprioritization and malnutrition.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits reactive elevation of circulating platelet counts (>450,000/µL) driven by systemic inflammatory cytokines.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits peripheral white blood cell counts between 10,000 and 16,000/µL with neutrophilia and toxic granulations.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits elevated hepatic alkaline phosphatase levels resulting from space-occupying intrahepatic granulomas.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Exhibits delayed-type hypersensitivity induration (>5 mm at 48 hours) to intradermal paracoccidioidin, indicative of intact cell-mediated immunity.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits bilateral, symmetrical coarse reticulonodular and alveolar infiltrates radiating outwards into perihilar and mid-lung zones on chest radiography.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits perihilar pulmonary consolidations that spare the extreme apical and basal lung parenchymal zones.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits central ground-glass attenuation completely or partially encircled by a dense ring of consolidation on high-resolution thoracic CT.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits smooth or nodular interstitial thickening of interlobular septa producing a prominent polygonal reticular network on chest CT.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits small, poorly defined soft-tissue attenuation nodules distributed around terminal bronchioles on thoracic CT.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits hazy areas of increased lung attenuation with preservation of underlying bronchial and vascular architecture on CT.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits thick, linear non-vascular opacities extending from the visceral pleura into the lung parenchyma reflecting organizing fibrosis.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits irregular bronchial dilatation within areas of dense pulmonary scarring caused by retractile interstitial fibrosis.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits relative radiological preservation of extreme apex segments, distinguishing pulmonary paracoccidioidomycosis from classic reactivated tuberculosis.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits characteristic freedom from consolidation in the extreme costophrenic angles and basal lung segments.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits diffuse enlargement of both adrenal gland limbs on abdominal CT or ultrasonography with preservation of overall contour.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits punctate or rim-like high-density calcific deposits along adrenal margins in chronic or healed granulomatous disease.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits low-density central necrotic areas within enlarged adrenal glands on contrast-enhanced CT.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits confluent, conglomerate intra-abdominal and mesenteric nodal enlargement with low-attenuation centers on abdominal CT.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits well-circumscribed cortical bone destruction with minimal periosteal reaction on plain radiographs of the ribs, clavicles, or skull.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Exhibits focal round lesions with peripheral ring-like gadolinium enhancement and marked perilesional vasogenic edema on brain MRI.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves airborne inhalation of infectious microconidia aerosolized from disturbed, acidic, humid topsoil in rural ecosystems.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves manual labor during coffee plant cultivation, soil weeding, and crop harvesting that generates dense particulate dust containing fungal propagules.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves intense manual soil manipulation and leaf curing activities strongly associated with elevated occupational risk of fungal spore exposure.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves environmental contact with sandy, acidic soils (pH 4.5-6.0) near riverbanks in subtropical and tropical rainforest biomes where Paracoccidioides survives.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves contact with Dasypus novemcinctus burrows, the premier wild animal reservoir harboring systemic Paracoccidioides infection.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves proximity to free-roaming domestic and working dogs in rural endemic areas demonstrating natural subclinical and clinical fungal infection.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves massive mechanical land clearance, highway construction, and earth-moving activities in frontier zones producing infectious aerosols.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves exposure to major environmental modifications and massive earth moving in river valleys such as Yacyreta and Madeira river projects.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves geographic confinement to continental Latin America, bounded geographically between southern Mexico and northern Argentina.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves exposure within Brazil, which accounts for greater than 80% of all reported paracoccidioidomycosis cases worldwide.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves exposure in frontier agricultural zones of the Western Amazon and Center-West regions of Brazil, such as Rondonia and Acre.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves rural exposure within coffee-growing regions of the Andean mountain ranges in Colombia, a major secondary endemic zone.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Involves residence or agricultural labor in Bolivar state and northern mountainous agricultural regions of Venezuela.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Features an overwhelming male-to-female clinical disease ratio of 10:1 to 15:1 in adult cohorts despite equal gender infection rates.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Reflects direct inhibition by female 17-beta-estradiol binding to fungal cytoplasmic receptors, blocking conidia-to-yeast transition in premenopausal females.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Features an over 14-fold elevated risk of chronic adult disease in individuals with long-standing daily cigarette smoking histories.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Features markedly increased risk of progressive disease in individuals consuming distilled alcoholic beverages exceeding 50 grams per day.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Features highest vulnerability among rural manual laborers, subsistence farmers, and tractor drivers exposed to continuous soil aerosol clouds.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Features accelerated, severe, multi-organ dissemination in patients with HIV infection, organ transplants, or hematological malignancies.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Features host genetic susceptibility associated with elevated frequency of HLA-A9, HLA-B13, and specific cytokine gene polymorphisms.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Spans a prolonged incubation of 10 to 30 or more years between primary rural fungal infection and symptomatic adult reactivation.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Spans a short incubation timeframe of weeks to months following acute conidial exposure in young hosts lacking cellular immunity.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Manifests decades after emigrating from endemic Latin American countries, presenting unexpectedly in non-endemic global territories.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes paracoccidioidomycosis when symptoms develop within 48 to 72 hours, as the disease is inherently subacute or chronic in evolution.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Strongly argues against chronic multifocal paracoccidioidomycosis due to potent protective hormonal inhibition by circulating 17-beta-estradiol.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Conclusively excludes paracoccidioidomycosis in individuals who have never resided in or traveled to continental Latin America.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Argues against paracoccidioidomycosis because direct person-to-person or animal-to-human transmission never occurs in clinical practice.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes paracoccidioidomycosis when oral ulcers or pulmonary infiltrates resolve rapidly following standard beta-lactam or macrolide therapy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Argues against paracoccidioidomycosis when cutaneous manifestations consist exclusively of superficial non-ulcerative scaly desquamation without mucosal involvement.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Casts doubt on the diagnosis when repeated direct KOH smears, silver stains, and cultures of active ulcerative lesions fail to demonstrate fungal forms.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Argues strongly against active untreated systemic paracoccidioidomycosis when double immunodiffusion against specific gp43 antigen is completely negative.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Argues against primary paracoccidioidomycosis when pulmonary imaging reveals strictly isolated unilateral apical thick-walled cavity without mid-zone disease.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Decreases pretest probability significantly in individuals with strictly metropolitan, non-agricultural lifestyles devoid of outdoor soil contact.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes active paracoccidioidomycosis when destructive ulcerative mucosal lesions heal spontaneously without antifungal pharmacological therapy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Argues against paracoccidioidomycosis when an infection cluster is claimed to have spread directly between living household animal contacts.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes paracoccidioidomycosis when repeated adequate deep tissue biopsies reveal only nonspecific chronic inflammation without granulomas or yeast elements.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes paracoccidioidomycosis when an illness outbreak follows contaminated municipal water drinking rather than inhalation of disturbed soil aerosols.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Decreases likelihood of classic chronic adult paracoccidioidomycosis when prolonged respiratory symptoms lack any upper aerodigestive tract or skin lesions.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Strongly argues against true drug-sensitive paracoccidioidomycosis when compliant therapeutic dosing of itraconazole produces no clinical or serological response.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes fungal Addisonian crisis when an acutely hypotensive, exhausted patient demonstrates brisk cortisol elevation above 25 µg/dL.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Argues against untreated disseminated chronic disease when comprehensive chest CT fails to show any interstitial, nodular, or fibrotic lesions.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes paracoccidioidomycosis when blood smears reveal intracellular red blood cell trophozoites or ring forms diagnostic of malaria or babesiosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Points away from isolated paracoccidioidomycosis when sputum direct microscopy shows red rod-shaped acid-fast bacilli diagnostic of mycobacterial infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes paracoccidioidomycosis when biopsies show exclusively tiny 2-4 µm yeasts packed inside histiocytes with single narrow-based buds.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Excludes benign fungal moriform stomatitis when punch biopsy reveals invasive dysplastic squamous cells with keratin pearls and cellular anaplasia.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as tuberculosis predominantly causes apical and posterior upper lobe cavitary disease with acid-fast bacilli, whereas paracoccidioidomycosis exhibits symmetrical mid-zone bat-wing infiltrates, moriform stomatitis, and pilot's wheel multi-budding yeasts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as espundia primarily erodes the anterior nasal cartilaginous septum producing tapir nose deformity while sparing the lungs, whereas paracoccidioidomycosis targets the oropharyngeal mucosa and larynx with widespread pulmonary bat-wing fibrosis.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Histoplasma capsulatum produces tiny 2 to 4 µm narrow-based single budding yeasts inside macrophages, whereas Paracoccidioides produces massive 15 to 30 µm extracellular yeast cells with circumferential daughter buds.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as oral carcinoma features hard rolled indurated borders with central necrosis and dysplastic malignant keratinocytes on histopathology, whereas moriform stomatitis exhibits friable mulberry-like pinpoint dots and responds to azole therapy.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Blastomyces dermatitidis features large thick-walled yeasts with broad-based single buds, endemic to North America, unlike the multiple narrow-necked pilot-wheel budding of Paracoccidioides in Latin America.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Coccidioides produces large spherules (20 to 100 µm) packed with endospores in arid desert soils of the Americas, lacking the characteristic circumferential budding yeasts and mulberry oral lesions.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Cryptococcus neoformans demonstrates mucicarmine-positive thick polysaccharide capsules and narrow-based single budding on India ink preparation without moriform stomatitis.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Sporothrix schenckii classically causes nodular ascending lymphocutaneous cord lesions following minor plant thorn trauma, lacking bilateral pulmonary bat-wing consolidations.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as lymphoma presents with painless non-suppurating lymphadenopathy containing Reed-Sternberg cells on nodal biopsy without fistulizing abscesses or multi-budding fungal elements.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as lymphoid neoplasms exhibit clonal malignant lymphocyte proliferation on immunohistochemistry, lacking granulomatous micro-abscesses with mariner's steering wheel yeasts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as sarcoidosis presents with non-caseating naked epithelioid granulomas and bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy without ulcerating moriform stomatitis or fungal structures on silver stain.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as granulomatosis with polyangiitis features PR3-ANCA seropositivity, necrotizing vasculitis, and glomerulonephritis rather than infectious dimorphic yeasts with high anti-gp43 antibodies.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as intestinal Crohn's disease causes non-caseating transmural granulomas with skip lesions and anti-Saccharomyces antibodies, lacking pulmonary bat-wing fibrosis or mucosal mulberry ulcers.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as tertiary syphilis manifests with positive treponemal serology (VDRL/FTA-ABS) and endarteritis obliterans with plasma cells, responding curative to penicillin rather than antifungal azoles.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Actinomyces israelii forms indurated cervicofacial woody lesions draining sulfur granules containing gram-positive filamentous branching bacteria rather than large multi-budding yeasts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as pyogenic adenitis is an acute bacterial infection responding rapidly to beta-lactam antibiotics and demonstrating polymorphonuclear neutrophilic infiltrate without chronic granulomas.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Talaromyces marneffei is endemic to Southeast Asia, produces distinctive soluble red pigment on Sabouraud agar, and multiplies by binary fission with central septation rather than circumferential budding.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Contrasts with Paracoccidioidomycosis as Pneumocystis causes acute hypoxemic respiratory failure with cup-shaped cysts in severely immunocompromised hosts (CD4 < 200), lacking oropharyngeal ulcerative moriform lesions.

entities.name: Scabies
entities.description: Contagious ectoparasitic skin infestation caused by Sarcoptes scabiei var. hominis, clinically characterized by intense nocturnal pruritus, pathognomonic serpiginous intraepidermal burrows, male genital nodules, and secondary pyoderma.

entities.name: Classical Scabies
entities.description: Standard clinical syndrome of scabies presenting with a low mite burden (10-15 mites), nocturnal pruritus, and excoriated papules in classic web and flexural locations.

entities.name: Crusted Scabies
entities.description: Severe hyperkeratotic variant of scabies harboring thousands to millions of mites, with extensive scaling, crusting, and high contagiousness occurring in immunocompromised individuals.

entities.name: Nodular Scabies
entities.description: Exquisitely pruritic, firm inflammatory nodules on male genitalia, groin, or axillae representing delayed-type hypersensitivity that often persist for months following curative therapy.

entities.name: Infantile Scabies
entities.description: Atypical pediatric presentation in children under two years characterized by breakdown of adult sparing rules, involving the scalp, face, neck, palms, and soles with vesicular lesions.

entities.name: Bullous Scabies
entities.description: Rare blistering presentation of scabies mimicking bullous pemphigoid, predominantly observed in elderly patients and characterized by tense intraepidermal or subepidermal bullae.

entities.name: Scabies Incognito
entities.description: Clinically masked or atypical presentation of scabies resulting from topical or systemic corticosteroid misuse, dampening inflammation while permitting extensive mite proliferation.

entities.name: Geriatric Scabies
entities.description: Scabies presentation in elderly and bedridden individuals characterized by atypical distribution on the back, neck, and scalp, often with attenuated pruritus and high transmission risk.

entities.name: Scalp Scabies
entities.description: Cutaneous mite involvement of the scalp and hair-bearing cranial vault, typically seen in infants, bedridden elderly individuals, or patients with crusted hyperinfestation.

entities.name: Canine Scabies Transmission
entities.description: Transient, self-limiting zoonotic infestation transmitted from domestic dogs with sarcoptic mange, causing pruritic papules without epidermal burrowing or sustained human transmission.

entities.name: Impetigo
entities.description: Superficial contagious bacterial pyoderma predominantly caused by Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pyogenes complicating excoriated scabietic skin breaches.

entities.name: Ecthyma
entities.description: Deep ulcerative cutaneous bacterial infection extending through the epidermis into the dermis, characterized by punched-out ulcers with thick hard crusts.

entities.name: Cellulitis
entities.description: Acute, spreading bacterial infection of the deep dermis and subcutaneous tissues arising from secondary inoculation through excoriated scabies lesions.

entities.name: Cutaneous Abscess
entities.description: Localized collection of purulent exudate within dermis and subcutaneous tissues resulting from pyogenic bacterial superinfection of excoriated scabietic skin.

entities.name: Furunculosis
entities.description: Painful necrotizing infection of hair follicles with purulent discharge resulting from secondary Staphylococcal superinfection of excoriated skin.

entities.name: Post-Streptococcal Glomerulonephritis
